sarveśvarī yādivarṇa catuṣṭaya dhṛtāmaṇau evaṃ vāgdevatā nyāsaṃ nyased varṇān mahāmano śrotrayoryugalecāpi mukhe ca bhujayostathā nyasya vā nyasya vā ṣoḍhā cakranyāsā ubhau priye abhyarcyagaṃdhapuṣpādaiḥ sādhāraṃ śaṃkhamarcayet akadādi [kh: akathādi] trirekhāṃtā halakṣābhyaṃtarasthitam tadaṃbhasā puro bhāge caturaśraṃ ṣaḍaśrakam ādhāramanunādhātra pūjanīyāḥ śuceḥ kalāḥ abhyarcya bhāskarakalāstataścādimapūraṇam upādimaṃ madhyamaṃ [kh: mādhyamaṃ] ca tatra nikṣipya buddhimān koṇeṣu bālāmālikhya bahiṣṣaṭkoṇamālikhet arghyaṃ spṛṣṭvā sṛṣṭimukhaiścaturnavati raśmibhiḥ etairmaṃtrairmaṃtritaṃ syādādimaṃ paramāmṛtam paramānaṃdajanako bhavet sidhyaikasādhanaḥ trikhaṇḍamudrayā bāhya saptamudrāśca darśayet vaṃdanaṃ dhenu yonī ca saptamudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ catuṣṣaṭyupacārāṇāṃ maṃtrā devī pṛthak pṛthak aṃgamaṃtrairaṃgaṣaṭkaṃ tithi nityāśca ṣoḍaśa śirasi svaguroḥ pādau bhaktipūrṇaḥ samarcayet abhyaṃtaramahīgehe brāhmādyāḥ [kh: brāhmyā-] parikīrtitāḥ samarpaṇenamanunā yoginībhyaḥ samarcayet saṃkṣobhamudrāṃ saṃdarśya [kh: -śyaṃ] ṣoḍaśāraṃ prapūjayet arcyāstu guptayoginya [kh: -nyas] tripureśīti cakriṇī anaṃgakusumādyāstu śaktayastatra saṃsthitāḥ mudrā cā karṣiṇī jñeyā tatastu bhuvanārake

saṃpradāyāstu yoginyastripurā śrīśca cakriṇī sarvasidhyādikāḥ [kh: -kā] śaktiḥ kulottirṇā tu yoginī aṃtardaśāredevyastu sarvajñādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ mahāṃkuśā ca mudrāsyādathāṣṭāra mahāvṛtau cakriṇī tripurā siddhā mudrā bhavati khecarī tryaśe [kh: tryaśre] kāmeśvarī vajreśvarī ca bhagamālinī yoginyati rahasyā ca tripurāṃbā ca cakriṇī biṃdurūpe mahollāse lalitāṃ parameśvarīm tasyā ekāsane [kh: ṭakāsane] deva matisaṃsaktavigraham kaṃdarpa koṭilāvaṇyaṃ puṣpabāṇadhanurddharam hakārādyena maṃtreṇa kāmeśvaramupācaret itthaṃ navāvṛtiṃ [kh: -kṛtiṃ] devīṃ [kh: devī] pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ saubhāgyahṛdayaṃ japtvā dhyāyet kāmakalāmatha atha saṃtarpya mūlābhyāṃ devaṃ devīṃ ca pūjayet ekībhūte tayordehe [kh: -ho] yajedānaṃda bhairavam bindubhistarpayennāthamānaṃda [kh: baṃdhu-] parameśvaram yāgarājakramasyeti nāṃdi pūjā smṛtā [kh: smṛtair] budhaiḥ yaṃ śrutvā sahā * [kh: sahaṃsā] siddhi pūjayed [kh: -yad] yadi mānavaḥ ityānaṃdataṃtre ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ yāgarājavidhānaṃ ca marutāmapi durlabham [kh: -bha] paramānaṃdasaubhāgya nimittaṃ sarvasiddhidam prativarṣaṃ tu vihitaṃ kalpitaṃ tasya siddhaye parvasukriyamāṇastu kadācidapi vāṃcchitam brahmarūpeṇa suśroṇimayā [kh: suśroṇī-] sṛṣṭā jagattraye [kh: jagatraye] vyastānāṃ ca samastānāṃ rasena kriyate madhu

sarvāḥ [kh: sarvā] striyomayā sṛṣṭāḥ liṃgeśvarasamarcane prācyāṃgānāmudīcyānāmaṃgānāmapi madhyamaḥ gaṃdhapuṣpaṃ ca tāṃbūlamāleporati bheṣajam paṃcamāścāpare [kh: -rī] paṃcadaśaite yāgasādhanam tatrāpi mukhyau dvāvevatvādimaḥ paṃcamaḥ priye ādimaṃ cāpyaṃtimaṃ ca sārabhūtaṃ janārdanaḥ aṣṭamenāvatāreṇa baladeva svarūpiṇā anaṃtamūrtināyena rohiṇī garbhajanmanā tasya devasya mahato balabhadrasya dhīmataḥ revatī vadanāṃ bhojavāsitaṃ madhuraṃ madhu kṛṣṇājñayā baleṃdrasya varuṇenopaḍhaukitā [kh: -lokitā] gomaṃtaparvatopāṃtanīpa koṭarato bhavat [kh: bhavet] naṃdānaṃdasamudrasya samuttaṃbhasitatviṣā upasaṃgrahaṇaṃ cakre bhagavānabjalocanaḥ kaṃsapratāraṇāyātha naṃdasyātmajatāṃ gataḥ gopīḥ [kh: gopī] nisargamadhurāḥ prakṛtyā suraceṣṭitāḥ na tā gopyo guṇodārāḥ [kh: -rā] yena bhuktāmurāriṇā svānaṃdamūrti sidhyarthametāsumuraśāsanaḥ muralīvādakṛtyena vallavīrabhinaṃdayan puṇḍrekṣu cāpasahita puṣpāśuga pariṣkṛtam cikrīḍabahudhā kṛṣṇaścitrābhiḥ kulaśaktibhiḥ [kh: kula *?kti-] narakeṇāvaruddhānāṃ sahasrāṇyapi ṣoḍaśa ataḥ pradhānamānaṃda devapūjanakarmaṇi [kh: -ṇī] pūjayā [kh: pūjāyā] api sarvasyā viśrāṃtistatra pārvatī āvirbhavaṃti yatraiva svānaṃdagradilāstviṣaḥ [kh: -grahilāstviṣaḥ]

namaskṛtya maheśānīṃ mahātripurasuṃdarīm pradakṣiṇa namaskārān kṛtvā bhaktiparānataḥ [kh: -bharānataḥ] maṃtreṇānena tatpāde vikṣipan daṃḍavannamet ānaṃdayāgamadhunā karomyanugṛhāṇamām svaguruṃ gurupatnīṃ ca dviṣaṭkiṃte [kh: dviṣaṭkāṃte] triśo'rcayet kulākulāṣṭakādīni nimaṃtryāhūyaśobhitām abhyarcya sarvamapyaṃgamavamṛjyavicakṣaṇaḥ athavā citramathavā patrorṇaṃ sumanoharam kāṃcīlatā tulākoṭi hāraikāvali vālibhiḥ anyaiścā bharaṇaistāṃtu bhūṣayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ na viraktā navātyaṃta raktā na kalaha priyā nānyaraktā nātipuṣṭā nātikharvā navākṛśā narūkṣāṃgī [kh: -gi] na jihmākṣī [kh: jiṃhā-] na ca karkaśa kīkasā na kuṭṭanī [kh: -ni] samācārā nopahāsaparāyaṇā na durgaṃdhā na duḥśīlā na ca duṣparivādinī na dīrgharogagrastāṃgī yogyā bhavati dūtikā śārīramathajīvasya saṃskāradvitayaṃ dhruve [kh: dhṛve] abhyaṃgodvartane caiva snānamālepanaṃ tataḥ mradīyavastradharaṇaṃ yavakālaṃ kṛtiḥ paṭe [kh: * *?] ālomaśaṃtvaṃ [kh: -śatvaṃ] svacchatvaṃ ślakṣṇatvaṃ ca sugaṃdhitā sukomalatvaṃ śuddhatvaṃ susparśatvaṃ ca pārvati [kh: -tī] svabhāva sukumāratvaṃ svabhāvena sugaṃdhitā ativaiśālya rāhityamatisaṃkoca hīnatā aṣṭabhogopadheyatvaṃ bhogavegasahiṣṇutā atyaṃtacaṇḍakaṇḍūyā rahitatvaṃ ca pārvati [kh: -tī]

akliṣṭatā puṣṭatā ca rathanemisamānatā [kh: radhane-] phaṇiśīrṣasamānatvaṃ prasannadravatā tathā sarvalakṣaṇa yuktatvaṃ kulakṣaṇavihīnatā saṃskārasya mahimneva [kh: mahimnaiva] bhāsaṃte te guṇāḥ priye saṃskāropi samastāni vastūninyāvasetpriye [kh: vastūnyāsādayet-] sarvasaubhāgyajanakaṃ sarvasiddhimahāpadaṃ ānaṃda bhairavasyārcāsādhanaṃ viśvamohanam suśobhadakramagrāsī samastāpannikṛṃtanam [kh: namastā-] veśmacaṃdrakalānāṃ ca sadmasaubhāgyasaṃpadām samastarogajanakaṃ daurbhāgyasyapravartakam [kh: daurbbhāgyasya-] lokopakrośajanakaṃ lokadhikkāradāyakam phelinaṃ [kh: phenilaṃ] naṣṭamucchiṣṭamapakṛṣṭaṃ vicarcitam aṃtaḥ karkkaśacarmāḍhyamaṃtargojihvayānvitam pāmakaṇḍūpracuritaṃ pāpiṣṭaṃ kathitaṃ dravam svakīya vapure vai tat pūjāsādhanamiṣyate [kh: -na*? ṣyate] sannidhatte paraḥsākṣādānaṃdādvaita rūpadhṛt dūtī mukhasya saṃskāraḥ kathyate śṛṇusaṃdari [kh: śruṇusuṃdarī] uttejanaṃ ca śastreṇa nirmalīkaraṇaṃ punaḥ tailagaṇḍuṣaṇāt kāṃtirdaṃtānāmupajāyate trikaṭu triphalāmāṃsi guḍatvakpatrakesaraiḥ kṛtvākṣa sadṛśān piṇḍān taṃ pūrvaṃ dūtikāgilet malenaivāpa sṛṣṭānāṃ sarveṣāṃ śamanaṃ bhavet mardaniyaṃ [kh: -niyyaṃ] prayatnena guṭikākārayedbudhaḥ pūtikāmati [kh: dūtikā-] saurabhya śālivaktraṃ prakalpayet itthaṃ śarīrasaṃskāro bāhyābhyaṃtara īritaḥ

tasyāpi devi saṃskāraṃ bruvebāhyamathāṃtaram dūtikā jīvanāthopi saṃskāraṃ paramarhati yadasaṃge'pi jīvākhye śive khelati nirbhayā svajīvākhya maheśasya bādya [kh: nādya] vidyāvakuṃṭhitaḥ malāpanodikāḥ kiṃtu samastāḥ pūjanakramāḥ tat saṃsargavaśācchuddha svātmāpi malinī bhavet samayaśravaṇaṃ tasyāḥ prathamaṃ parikīrtitam alpavarṇena [kh: -vargeṇa] maṃtreṇa pāśanirdahakāriṇā [kh: -rīṇī] na rāgānna ca lobhādvā na ca mohānmahīyasaḥ [kh: -mahiyyasaḥ] prakṛtyāmugdhamanasastriyastatvaṃ na jānate śayāḥ] stanottaṃbhana dṛṣṭena yauvanena madoddhatāḥ aviśvāsaḥ samasteṣu pratyayona gurorgiri manyamānādurācārāḥ pataṃtinarake striyaḥ tāṃbūlamanulepaṃ ca vāsaśca mukhavāsikā sarvametan maheśasya pūjāsādhanitaṃ yathā asmadvapuridaṃ tucchaṃ pūjāsādhanituṃ budhaiḥ sālabheduttamāllo/kān [kh: -mānlokān] sādhakena mahātmanā viṣṇuloke rudraloke krīḍaṃti bahuvibhramāḥ ityādibhiryūkti yuktairvaca naiḥ śāstrasammitaiḥ ānaṃdabhairavīṃ cāpi maṃtreṇābāhya sādhakaḥ [kh: -kāḥ] tryaśre sthitāḥ punaḥ pūjyā rati prītimanobhavāḥ drāviṇī śoṣiṇī caivaṃ [kh: caiva] baṃdhinī mohinī tathā paṃcārasyāṃ cale pūjyāḥ kāmarājomaheśvarī [kh: -maleśvarī] manobhavaḥ paṃcamaśca jagatkṣobhakarā ime

anaṃgaśaktayoṣṭau tu pūjanīyāmanīṣibhiḥ [kh: pūjanīya -] anaṃgamadanānaṃga madanāturayā saha [kh: sahā] anaṃgamālinī cāṣṭau pūjanīyā vidhānataḥ ānaṃdacakramānaṃda kolāhalavivarddhanam taṭitprabhā samullāsapiṃjaraiḥ kāmaraśmibhiḥ anaṃgaśakti saṃkṣobhāṃ nāḍībhyogalitaṃ navam śṛṃgāravāhinīpūra pūrṇarāgāṃ kurāruṇam manmathadrava saṃdoha juṣṭamarthaprabhedanaiḥ [kh: -marttha-] keyaṃ caṃdrakalānāma kutra tiṣṭhati śaṃkara śṛṇukāmakalānāma [kh: śruṇu-] nāḍībhogāṃbuvāhinī nāḍīcakraṃ samastaṃ ca tayā vyāptaṃ varānane kāścidānaṃdavāhinya [k: nāsti] ekaivamalavāhinī aṣṭaubhogāṃbuvāhinyaḥ [kh: -nyas] tāsu caṃdrakalā parā caṃdrarekhā caṃdravatī tathā caṃdramahodayā etābhogāṃbuvāhinya svāṃśaiścaṃdrakalāśritāḥ pradhānabhūtā vilasadvidyuddāma samaprabhā sarvanāḍīmūlabhūtaṃ nābhicakraṃ samāśritā tanmukhot ghāṭanaṃ loke durlabhaṃ parameśvari [kh: -rī] dvitrāṇāmeva jāyeta sahasreṣvathakauliṣu yasya liṃgesvarāseka sakṛdvāpīhajanmani [kh: sarvakṛdvā-] anirvācyasya nirvāṇa padavīnadaviyasī [kh: -viyyasī] samayasya parijñānādupacārasya kalpanāt kadācit kvacidunmeṣaṃ mukhodghāṭanalakṣaṇam tadarthānyevaśāstrāṇi tadarthāśca pravṛttayaḥ tasmāccaṃdrakalānāḍyāṃ bhogāmṛtamahodadhim

kuṃkumadravasaṃkāśaṃ vilīnāśeṣa ceṣṭitam rakṣitaṃ bhāvayed devī tasyāścaṃdrakalodaye sadyaḥ pulakitākāro bhāvaḥ ko'pi vijṛṃbhate nṛtyatīvasamutkaṃṭhā nṛtyatī va śirāmukham [kh: śivā-] dūtikā smara gehasthāṃ bhagamālāṃ samarcayet tasyāścārcana bhedastu vaktavyaḥ parameśvara bhagamālīti niḥśeṣa bhagacakrābhimāninī viśvasaṃohanākārā viśvajanmamahāsthali [kh: -sthiti] kālarūpākālakarī kālagrasanalālasā samasteṣu śarīreṣu puṃsāṃstrīṇāmathāpivā saṃhita [kh: -tā] śatasāhasre [kh: -sri] yadarthe kīrtyate mayā nityānaṃga madonmattā yauvanenātigarvitā pāśāṃkuśau karaṃ dhanva tadā vā madhubhājanam prasannavadanāṃbhojā madaraktavilocanā svaraktakāṃtiśaṭībhirevāvṛtanitaṃbabhūḥ [kh: [kh: -śāṭībhi-] digaṃbarābhiranyābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritā 55k) evaṃ dhyeyā maheśāni devatā bhagamālinī tripurārghyāṃbunā prokṣya dūtyāḥ [kh: dūtyā] smaraniketanam trikoṇaṃ paṃcakoṇaṃ ca sāṣṭārakacaturddalam madhye jayenmahādevīṃ mādyaṃtīṃ bhagamālinīm bhagaguhyaṃ bhagayoniṃ tathā bhaganipātinīm bhagarūpāṃ tadā devīṃ [kh: devī] nityaklinnāmbikāmapi bhagaklinnāmaṣṭamīṃ ca sādhakovidhivarttanā amoghabhagavidyā ca caturthi [kh: -rtthi] tu bhageśvarī tripurārghya sthitaireva biṃdubhistat prapūjayet

pūrvokta [kh: -ktaṃ] yattu hṛccakraṃ dūtikāyāḥ prakīrttitam evaṃ yonigataṃ cakraṃ pūjayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ cakrapūjena śuddhena tripurārghyeṇa bhāsvatā [kh: bhā * *?] taccodhitena dravyeṇa pūritaṃ sa dvitīyakam dūtīhastagate [kh: -haste-] tasmin pātre pūritasīdhuni [kh: -nī] mukhaṃ biṃduṃ vidhāyātha biṃduyugmena tat kucau jvalatkāmakalākārāsyaṃdamānāmṛtadravaiḥ dhyātakāmakalāpūtayeta dravyaṃ pibaṃtitāḥ pradravaṃti ca mūrcchaṃti layaṃ yāṃti pade pade dūtikājīvanāthasya yā sā saṃskṛtirāṃtarī ayamābhyaṃtaraḥ proktaḥ saṃskārojīvaśodhakaḥ jīvanāthasya devasya sūcitonopapāditaḥ kiṃkaroti ca dehasya praviśannaṃtaraṃ guṇam idaṃ pavitramamṛtaṃ bhavabheṣajamūciret [kh: -re] pratyakṣasaukhyajanakaṃ bahupratyayadāyakam nānāvidhānāṃ vasudhājanmanāṃ puṇyavīrudhām ṣaḍbhiśca [kh: ṣaḍhbhiśca] nānāvidhatāṃ prāptairasakadaṃbakaiḥ kaṣāyaṃ khalurogārtaḥ pibatyauṣadhavīrudhām namoyasya tvanirvācyā śaktiḥ śailatanūbhavet tathauṣadhānāṃ ca śiveśaktiḥ pratyayakāriṇī tanuparyanuyojyatvā [kh: -tvaṃ] mātṛkasyāpi vādinaḥ atastathauṣadhānāṃ ca śaktirasyeva pārvati [kh: -tī] pratyauṣadhaṃ bhinnabhinnāḥ [kh: -bhinnā] śaktayastatra pārvati [kh: -tī] anyonyāḥ śaktayonūnamāvisyaṃtyeva vīrudhām svataṃtrāstvekayā śaktyā nikṛtaṃti mahāgadān

rogāṇyavaśyaṃ nighnaṃti svabhāvo vāsya vastunaḥ [kh: -na] sa vīrabhadraḥ suśroṇi sākṣāt saṃhāra bhairavaḥ dakṣakopātprajvalataḥ [kh: -tas] tasyāṃgādromakūpataḥ tamanuproddhitāḥ sarve vyādhayovividhakramāḥ atyaṃtalolādurvārāḥ [kh: -dāḥ] prajvalaṃtaḥ sadāmuṣā [kh: -juṣā] tamāśritya mahāsatvaṃ vīrabhadraṃ mahodayam pāpaśīlān durācārān kanyāvidveṣakāriṇaḥ āgama [kh: -maḥ] drohiṇo pāpān vṛthākalahakāriṇaḥ [kh: vṛdhā-] bhakṣayaṃti mahārogāḥ pibaṃti rudhiraṃ bahu vṛdhe-] marmabheda karālāpāṃ dhārmikācāra niṃdakān hiṃsaṃti vyādhayastīvrāstatsaṃgādaparānapi [kh: -saṃgodaparānapi] āśaṃkamānairvilaya mahaṃsaṃprārthitaḥ [kh: -prārddhitaḥ] purā parabrahmaḥ sāsvādamayamānaṃdadāyakam [kh: rasā-] sa biṃdu śatasāhasra pravahaḥ pavanāhatam viveśacauṣadhiḥ [kh: -coṣadhiḥ] sarvāḥ somarūpomahārasaḥ tataḥ prabhṛti vīrutsujāgartti paramāmṛtam vividhaṃ vaidyataṃtraṃ tu jvarādīnāṃ vinuttaye śārīravaidyake proktāḥ prakvāthaghuṭikādayaḥ [kh: prakvādha-] yathā dehojvaraṃ śītaṃ pittaṃ śleṣmamalonilaḥ tathā jīve gadāḥ proktāḥ krodhodveṣaścamatsaraḥ nirvedaśca paritrāsaḥ śaṃkākutsitaciṃtanam vikaṃpatvaṃ vimūḍhatvaṃ vidyāloka navarjitam [kh: -va * *?] sarvasyakutsā śīlatvaṃ sarvatrāpi jugupsanam etā dṛśānaikabhedāḥ koṭīnāmapikoṭayaḥ

avidyā parirabdhasya jīvasyaite mahāgadāḥ pātayaṃti ca dṛṣṭeṣu duḥkhasaṃkramavarttmasu pāṭavopi vidhāvastu śaktayo yatra bhāṣitāḥ tasmādanenadravyeṇa nānauṣadhirasātmanā yathā jīvaśarīrasya [kh: -rastha] jīvasaṃskāra āṃtaraḥ tathā dūti śarīrasthā jīvadeva samāśrayā svabhāvato manasttrīṇāṃ vrīḍājaḍimabhājanam caṃcalaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ caiva kuṭilaṃ ca svabhāvataḥ atilolamanastrīṇāṃ sulabhaglāni ca svataḥ naśyaṃti vastuśaktīnāṃ manuṣe vaṇadhārayā argalākāmasarvasva dvārasyāśuvilīyate [kh: -viliyyate] abhogasamaye bhūya [kh: bhūyaḥ] prāptuṃ kutrāpi līyate [kh: liyyate] ānaṃdanātha pūjārthaṃ parivārāṃ ganā iva sakṛto dṛṣṭisaṃcārasmitamullāsamāṃsalam līlāvaśena dehasya ghūrṇanaṃ cāṭubhāṣaṇam ākūtasya samastasya svecchayaiva prakāśanam parīhāsakathālāpaḥ kiṃcidāviṣkṛtātrapā kilikiṃcita saṃcāraḥ krīḍāprāyaviceṣṭitaḥ pratyaṃgapulakodbhedaḥ pratyaṃgasvedabindavaḥ etā dṛśāguṇādūtyāmudbhavaṃti kulāmṛtaiḥ athāsvātmani vinyāsamānaṃdasyāpi kalpayet yathā cinmātra rūpatvaṃ tathā vastu prakalpayet [kh: * * *?yet] jīvarūpasya mahatā cidvahneḥ [kh: -vahnoḥ] prajvalattanoḥ tasmātpuṇyamidaṃ sevyaṃ madhurūpaṃ rasāyanam parāmṛtasyāhutivat śīlayet sarakakramam

ānaṃdataṃtre caivāsmin catvāraḥ paramīritāḥ [kh: -taḥ] tasmāccatvāra ullāsā iha proktā maheśvari [kh: -rī] tasmādānaṃda pūjāyā mālaṃvyaṃte tu na trayaḥ tathā tathā parānaṃda nāthavidyāṃ parāmṛśet dūtyā saṃdhukṣita svātmā naṃdamūrttiṃ guruṃ smaret dvādaśāṃtagate raktaśuklapāde vinikṣipet śivatvasāmrājya padābhiṣiktaṃ svaṃviciṃtayet paśyan pratyaṃgamaṃkūradanaṃ gottuṃgamānasaḥ yathā yauvanamullāsaṃ saṃprāpnotyaṃba dūtikā ālokaneratiḥ sākṣāt smite jāgarti jāhnavī [kh: jāhvavī] aśvinau nāsikābhāge tvoṣṭhe ca paramāmṛtam svede ca vāruṇī devī kāmanāthastvahaṃ kṛtau stanadvaye merugirirnniḥ śabdaṃ brahmamadhyame valitraye ca trailokyaṃ nābhigarbhe guhāṃbikā nakheṣu śītāṃ śu kalādormmūleṃkuśadevatāḥ kāverī caiva niśvāse godāsītkāra karmaṇi amalālāpakṛtyeṣu cittaviśrāṃti nāyakā vākptiḥ sukhahuṃkāre gīṣpatīkākukādhvanau iṃdraścittasamunnatyāmagnirvastu [kh: -tyā-agnir-] grasītviṣi hastādicālane yajñastvāśleṣe yajñapūruṣaḥ lāsyaṃ ca tāṃḍavaṃ devi tasyā dehādi ghūrṇane tānisarvāṇi varttate [kh: varttaṃte] tasyāgaṃḍūṣavastuni tatphalaṃ labhate dūtī sudhāgaṃḍūṣa sevanāt [kh: seva * ?] gaṃḍūṣamādiraṃ [kh: gaṃḍūṣaṃ-] devī vīrasyānaṃda varddhanam nityaklinnāsudhā devī rati prītiśca tadbhage

ānaṃdadeva pūjārthaṃ yogyatvaṃ pratipadyate ārādhanakramaṃ cāśu liṃgeśasya bravīmite cakrasthāṃ lalitā [kh: -tāṃ] devīmātmanyud vāsayet priye uparyadhomukhāṃbhoja [kh: -thomukhāṃ-] saṃpuṭīkṛta maṃṭape parāmṛtadhārābhirddhārāyaṃtramanohare [kh: paramāmṛtadhārā-] praveśayennijagṛhaṃ prakṛṣṭānaṃdanirbharaḥ tasyā evānaṃda kalāmanusaṃdadhadāśraye 69k) kṛtamudrā namaskāro yāgarājagṛhaṃ viśet kādaṃbarī rasāṃbhoja karaṃbitamukhāṃbujām śayyāyāstu caturdikṣu yajeddevī catuṣṭayam prathamāpītavarṇā syāt dvitīyā [kh: dvitiyyā] śyāmalākṛtiḥ ānaṃdanāthadevasya catasraḥ paricārikāḥ tāsāṃ maṃtreṇa naijena pūjanaṃ samudīritam pādukāṃ pūjayāmīti saptākṣaryā mahārhayā etairmaṃtraiḥ prahṛṣṭātmā gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ śṛṃgārapīṭhikāmaṃtro samūhyaḥ [k: * pyūhyaḥ] pūrvavatpriye bījamādau tatoṣṭārṇaṃ madhye nāma prakalpanam sarvatracakrapūjāsu viniyojyā hi bhūtaye paṃcakāmamahāyaṃtraṃ bhāvayitvārccayennaraḥ tataḥ ṣaṭkoṇamālikhya blūṣaṭkaṃ tatra [kh: * *?] saṃlikhet [kh: *?likhet] evaṃ viciṃtya tadyaṃtraṃ [kh: -tra] niryaṃtraṇa sukhāspadam kāmayaṃtroparivased dūtikā yadi pārvatī asaṃkhyātā sunāḍīṣu ye cānaṃdāḥ prakīrttitāḥ kaṃdarpa yaṃtra vedena jāyate divyabhoginī iththaṃ tayā samāsādya gātrasaṃgamahotsavam

anye vadaṃti manasi paremāruta ūcire matānyetānyacāruṇi vicāre saṃpravarttite manaso marutaścaiva saṃghaṭṭe vīryasaṃśrayā tayostu ghaṭanārthaṃ ca yogataṃtraṃ [kh: -tra] mayākṛtam rajasā vāyojayituṃ dhīmarudghaṭanaṃ prabhu taṣāmaṃto na cāsyevataiḥ phalaṃ na hi saṃbhavet ugraśakti madhusvādairuttarottaramuttaraiḥ gaulī saṃparkabalinā dhīmarudghaṭanātmanā vidyamāne tu hṛdaye nilaye ghaṭane punaḥ īṣaddhivāyughaṭanā sasonaiva prayojakaḥ ataścittasya maruto yogaḥ prathamamucyate pādāṃjaliṃ vā dhātuḥ sa yoge taddurllabho bhavet nādaiścagorakṣamukhaistaṃtrametadvitānatam yogena stabdhavīryāśca sadābhogānupāsate matsyeṃdranāgorakṣaścaturaṃgī [kh: -nāthagorakṣaśca-] ca kaṃdalī capeṭiko cūḍabālastathā gobāla [kh: gopāla] eva ca vyāloheraṇḍa nāmā ca śūrpapāyī tathā paraḥ etedhīrmaruto ghaṭṭaṃ kālasaṃkarṣaṇakṣamam khaṇḍayitvā kāladaṇḍaṃ brahmāṃḍeṣu caraṃti te tatsārabhūtaṃ tadvīryarakṣārthaṃ matamucyate tameva yogaṃ paramaṃ yoginaḥ samacakṣate ubhaujagatsṛṣṭikarau yanmanomāruteśvarau mahāsaṃvit prakāśātma svarūpavasunigrahau ubhau nāśayato deha krameṇa pariśīlitau mṛtyubhūtā vimāveva prāṇabhūtā vimau punaḥ

bahunā kimihoktena dvaumānasasamīraṇau tayoḥ saṃyojanaṃ vakṣye sāvadhānā śruṇu priye catuḥṣaṣṭyā tu mātrāṇāṃ pūrayenmāruteśvaram paṃcalaghvakṣaroccāra kālomātreti kathyate pūrakaḥ kuṃbhakaścaiva recakaśca maheśvari [kh: -rī] kākolakamukhaścava vāyupūraṇa bhadajāḥ yuktaṃ yuktaṃ ca gṛhṇīyā devaṃ siddhimavāpnuyāt śanaiḥ punarmokṣaṇaṃ syādyato vāyu jayobhavet sarvaṃ vyāpnoti ca vapuḥ sukhakārīvaśīkṛtaḥ sarveṣvapīhopāyeṣu maruddhāraṇakarmaṇaḥ dvāradṛṣṭirjjāgarīkavimarśaścāpi dhāvanam cāradṛṣṭiṃ yadā kuryāt tadā vāyu jayobhavet tadācoratvamujjhitvā pavanaḥ sakhyamīhate gṛho bhavati jīvo'yaṃ gṛhamedhīcidaṃganaḥ hetvaṃtamīhate vāyurmitatvacchanna [kh: -mitvatva-] taskaraḥ raṃdhra prahārīhartuṃ [kh: -rihartuṃ] tadāyurvittaṃ samīhate tātvikī tu bhaven maitrī yogināṃ [kh: -nā] dhīsamīrayoḥ ataścora [kh: ataḥ coraḥ] samīroyaḥ pratipālya prayatnataḥ rakṣatī va vapurgehaṃ kāpaṭyādvāyutaskaraḥ manaḥ pramādamālokya kadācilluṃṭate dinam ataḥ prakṛti corastu samūlamavakṛṃtati aṃtaḥ prakṛti corastu prakṛtīkāramarhati [kh: -tī] amoktavyaḥ sa yatnādvāpya pekṣyevaparāṃgatim satu coropi dharttavyaḥ samavekṣya pade pade anavekṣya bahiryāti tadā coro jihīrṣati [kh: jihirṣati]

āyurddhanasya rakṣāyāṃ svayameva pravarttate tasya prāṇavyayenāpi hitaṃ kāryaṃ samīhate [kh: sa * * *?] tena mārutanādasya vaśīkaraṇamaṃbike manasaikarasībhūya bhūyastanmayatāṃ brajet cāradṛṣṭyā vaśīkuryādanyatra na gatāśayaḥ vāyustanamayatāṃ yātaḥ kāryasiddhiṃ prayacchati cittaṃ tanmayataṃ yātāṃ siddhidvāraṃ prayacchati etat pravṛtterapara pravṛttiśca maheśvari [kh: -rī] manomārutanāśo hi tatsaṃdvāravihīnatā manoyatra prasarati tatra vāyuḥ pradhāvati pathāseṣu sthalebiṃdurnniyate manasāmunā tatrāti taralobiṃduranudhāvatya saṃśayaḥ manonātha sthirayate śuklaṃ caṃcalamapyasau āyuḥ saṃgrahaṇārthāya nigṛhṇīto raseśvaram sabiṃdu sthiratejāyuḥ sthirī bhavati pārvati [kh: -tī] kāṃtiḥ puṣṭiśca tuṣṭiśca rasanāthe pratiṣṭhitāḥ rase [kh: rasaṃ] tu stabdhatāṃ yāte stabdhaṃ tatsarvamaṃbike aṣṭāhutīnāṃ paryaṃte phalārthaṃ kriyate budhaiḥ tāvadannavimokṣe tu yajñavicchedavīśasaṃ vidhāya paścādgaulībhiḥ kuryātkabalabṛṃhaṇam [kh: -kubala-] atitīvromarudbhoktā manodhairyavivarddhanaḥ adhastādabhipātena prakvādhe satibhūyasā vidhānanālikā dvārā prāpyā sidhyati gaulikā tenāktavastraḥ pātrādau vahnirjvalati bhūyasā [kh: * * *?] tasmādatilaghusvacchā sarvavyādhivipāninī [kh: -tinī]

anilasyo dhṛtiharī manasodhairyavardhanī [kh: -varddhinī] upāsaniyā [kh: -niyyā] satataṃ [kh: -ta] mahāyāga pravarttibhiḥ aṣṭakāṣṭakaparyaṃtamapi biṃdurnniyacchataḥ gaulīrasasya prābalyāt stabdhavīryāmagātmaje yāgarāja pradhānāṃgaṃ labhyateṣṭāhuti kramāt aparaṃ kinnukalyāṇi praṣṭumutkaṃṭhitaṃ manaḥ tasya svarūpaṃ nirvaktu bhavāniṃdu śikhāmaṇe aṣṭāhutīravikalāḥ karoti sumahāśayaḥ tryaṣṭakāhutayaḥ puṃsastrailokyaṃ sādhayaṃti vai ye kurvaṃtyāhutiḥ puṇyāḥ [kh: puṇyā] jvalite liṃgapāvake teṣāṃ samastamaiśvaryaṃ saṃkalpādevasidhyati uttarottarameteṣāṃ nirvāṇa sukhahetutā tadekādūtikākuryādvyaṣṭake dūtikādvayam aṣṭau dūtyastu karttavyāḥ pūjanīyāśca [kh: -niyyāśca] tattvataḥ sa evābhyūhyatāmaṃba krameṇadvyaṣṭakādiṣu nānāvidhābhiḥ suśroṇi [kh: -ṇī] tasya vyarthāvibhūtayaḥ anaṃgamaṇināmasti sirāgṛddhirmanoharaḥ pradhitasyaṃ dinīceyaṃ vaśinī vāgvibhūtidā sādhuliṃgamaheśasya saṃghaṭṭana vitānataḥ tamālaśyāmalacchāyāmīccaiva kaṣāyitam [kh: * * * *?] mahānadīṣu sarvāsu viśiṣṭā parikīrttitā yastarpayati laiṃgāgniṃ sasarvatvaṃ samṛcchati ātmī kṛtya ca bhūtattvaṃ sarvatrāskhalitaṃ gatim labhate nityaniściṃtaḥ saṃcāraṃ yogamāyayā arcayāmi bhavadgātra mataḥsiddhiṃ prayacchame

arcayelliṃgamīśānamiyamādyā mayāhutiḥ [kh: mahā-] caṃdragarbheti kāpyasti nāḍīnalinalocane tatratyamamṛtaṃ viddhi kāmeśvaryuktibhūtidam īṣatpāṭalavarṇaṃ ca yūthikāsamasaurabham [kh: yūdhikā-] sabhavatyaṃ samāpanno jaladatvaṃ vaśīkriyāt na sarodeva svāteṣu [kh: ghāteṣu] skhalitaṃ gamanaṃ bhavet caṃdonmattā [kh: caṃdron-] padasthāne caṃdragarbhā prakīrttitā atradūtyāḥ śarīrasya pūrvatrāpi daśābruve īṣadāraktatānetre kiṃcidbhūvallitāṃḍavaṃ ānaṃdanātha bhavana bāhyakakṣyā vigāhanam stanayoḥ pulakāṃkūraḥ gaṃḍayoścānuraktatā evaṃ prakārā sā dūtī caṃdragarbhāmṛtadravaiḥ 88k) yajedānaṃdanāthaṃ sā vīravatphalamaśnute arthāṃguli samunnamra taptakāṃcanasannibhā tasyāścaṃdriṇikānāyā [kh: -nāḍyā] bhūyoliṃgeśatāḍavāt kādaṃbarī rasāmodīmānmadaṃtoya mudbhavet [kh: mu * *?] godāvarī tīrthamayī tayā siṃcenmaheśvaram rudratvasīmābhaktasya vahnitattva vaśīkṛtim tanoti bhagavāneṣaḥ mahānaṃda maheśvaraḥ umedāhaṃ prayacchaṃti svayamagni mayoyataḥ asyāmaṃtrastu suśroṇī śrūyatāmabhidhīyate [kh: -dhiyyate] arcayāmi bhavadgātra mataḥ siddhiṃ prayacchame athānyanāḍikādevī yā sā caṃdramahodayā aṃtaḥ kiṃcicchyāmavarṇātriṣu sthāneṣu vakritā līlānamrita gaurāṃgī valadbhrūvallibhāsurā

vidāritamukhī bhūyavimuṃcati parāmṛtam purāṇasīdhusaurabhyā nirbharaṃ śītalaṃlaghu sarasvatī śivalinītīrtha vaccāpi pāvanam vāyutattva samatvaṃ ca vaśīkuryādayatnataḥ hāṭhātvṛkṣasya [kh: haṭhāt-] bhaṃgeṣu hāṭhācchaila prakaṃpane caturāmnāya taṃtrokta sarvakarmaphalapradā dūtyāśarīralatikādaśāmapi śiveśṛṇu īṣadviśrāṃnti saṃcāra tārakā tāṃḍavaṃ dṛśoḥ maṃdasmitasamunmeṣo dṛśorānaṃda biṃdavaḥ etādṛśāguṇāṃ proktāstṛtīyāhuti karmaṇi [kh: -ṇī] prasaktapulakāṃkūra daṃturatvānniraṃtaram pīyaṃte [kh: piyyaṃte] bhogibhiḥ karṇairatyādarasamarpitaiḥ atīvapāṭalacchāyā gaṃḍayornnetrayorapi nijapārṣṇi praghātena todanaṃ nātha pṛṣṭhataḥ vahatāmanasā samyagānaṃdānnapraveśanam ahotvamānaṃda mayo māṃ majjayasi cinmukhe tathā kuru tathā nātha tathāmardayamardaya diśame sukhasarvasvamiti jalpaśatānyapi ityaṣṭakamahāhoma catuṣkaṃ samudīritam tasyāstu śubhage nāḍyāḥ pronnatārthāṃgulāvadhau vibhinnasphaṭikākārā sadā pulakitākṛtiḥ sadā sphuraṃtī dehasya kāṃtyunmeṣavivarddhinī liṃgaśaṃkarabhūyiṣṭha cāritāṃḍavaḍaṃbaraiḥ ghaṭanaṃ kramaśo yat tat cāritāṇḍavamācaran caṃdravatyamṛtaṃ sarvaṃ pracyāvayati suṃdari [kh: -rī]

kiṃcit piccilitāpannaṃ kiṃcidutsūkṣmabudbudam atyānaṃdakaraṃ devi [kh: devī] sparśanādeva bhoginām śoṇābhidhā mahātīrtha mayaṃśokaviśoṣaṇam liṃgarūpiṇamuddāmarāgajvālājaṭākulam mahāliṃga maheśāna rasaiścaṃdravatī bhavaiḥ bhaktasyeśānabhāvaṃ ca sūryatatvavaśīkṛtim iṃdriyāṇāṃ prabalatāṃ dūradṛṣṭimadāṃbike prayacchatyakhilāṃ siddhiṃ taijasīṃ viśvabhāsinīm anayā paṃcamāhutyā paṃcānanasamo bhavet paṃcamāhutikāle tu dūtyavasthā nivedyate [kh: ni * * *?] muhuḥ pakṣma [kh: pakṣmaḥ] praveśaśca netratārakayordvayoḥ utkaṇṭhataḥ kapotastrīgalagadgadabhāṣitam alamālāparacanaṃ punarutsāha bhāṣaṇam na kiṃcidapi jānāmi jātāhaṃ tava kiṃkarī ahaṃ tvadekaśaraṇārakṣarakṣa dṛḍhaṃjahi kiṃcidyonyavasādepi manasaḥ sumahodyamaḥ sarvesvapi ca gātreṣu madagaṃdhasamudbhavaḥ kāmārtta kurarīkaṃṭha rutavanmaṇitadhvaniḥ ityādayo guṇāḥ proktāḥ paṃcamyāmāhutau punaḥ arapaṃcaka saṃyuktā svastikākāraśālinī bibhratī caṃdraśiśirātasyā mastyamṛtaṃ vidhoḥ mardanāpekṣaṇī bhūyāstasmādeyā ciradravā liṃgeśvarasyaiva puramuddhatairūrdhvatāṇḍavaiḥ sravatyamṛtavicchardamaiṃdavaṃ [kh: sravacya-] harṣavardhanam tasya svarūpamadhunā vivicyakathayasvame [kh: viviccakatha-]

upariṣṭād dūtikāyāṃ sthitāyāmeva jāyate kiṃciccaracchuklabiṃdu kapaṭeṃduvibhūṣitaḥ yonigolakasaṃchannaḥ prakarotyūrdhvatāṇḍavam puruṣāyitaśabdena ghuṣyate madanāgame uparyullasati svairamutkaṃpi kucamaṃḍalā tatastu cāṃdramamṛtaṃ śivatvasya pradāyakam [kh: * * * *?] juhuyādāhutiṃ ṣaṭhīṃ maṃtreṇānena sādhakaḥ arcayāmi bhavdgātra mataḥ siddhiṃ prayacchame [kh: prayaccame] somāmṛtaṃ paraṃ pītvā cāgniṣomasvarūpadhṛk mahādevasya saṃsiddhiṃ somatattvasya paśyatām labhate caṃdravat kāṃtiṃ kāṃtyāviśvavimohinīm caṃdrasaumya mukhatvaṃ ca viṣanāśanapāṭavam vājīkaraṇalābhaṃ ca vināmaṃtrairvinauṣadhaiḥ bhogeṣva navasādaṃ ca prāpnotyānaṃda pūrṇatām ekākāreṇa sarveṣāmiṃdriyāṇāṃ [kh: -ṣāṃ miṃdri-] vilīnatā apāṃgemukulībhāvaḥ kāṃtirunmeṣiṇīmukhe atiśītalakarpūra parāgairivaliṃpati kaṃpracūcukacārubhyāṃ pūrṇābhyāṃ pulakāṃkuraiḥ padavikṣepasakṣepa protkṣepaṇa vidhāśataiḥ haṭhātka ca grahābhartturhaṭhācca [kh: -ṭhāśca] paricuṃbanam muhurutkṣipyanāthasya kaṃṭhaṃ tatra radakṣatiḥ tatkālenātha gātreṣu caṃdrāvasthā vilokanam ayināthamanonātha prāṇanātha priyāpriye [kh: priyātpriya] madaṃbānāthamannātha reremuṃcavimuṃcamāṃ kāhaṃ kastvaṃ kasyagṛhaṃ etat kinnumayocyate

na kiṃcidapi jānāmi nāthabodhayabodhaya etat saukhyanidānāya svastiliṃgāya śaṃbhave śivārpaṇamidaṃ bhūyāt punarastu śivārpaṇam [kh: * * * *?] mlānā padmamṛṇālī va mālikevāsya [kh: -ke * *?] vakṣasi [kh: * * si?] līnalīnākṣaraṃ paścānmaṃdamaṃdākṣaraṃ punaḥ evamādiguṇādūtyāḥ ṣaḍāhuti [kh: ṣaṣṭhāhuti] mahotsave ṣaṣṭhiṣaḍrasasaṃpanna bahubhojanadāyinī ṣaḍaṃgadevatā rūpā sarvadākriyatāṃbudhaiḥ nāyikāyāśca vidṛtyā sukhaśrāṃtiḥ pravartate śarkarāmṛtasaṃmiśraṃ śuddhiyūṣasanādhitam svayaṃtadavaśiṣṭaṃ ca pibed bhakti bharānataḥ maṃtraṃ cānaṃdadevasya śataśovāsahasraśaḥ ayuktayaṃtraḥ prajaped devatāśāpamāpnuyāt evaṃ japte parānaṃdarūpi liṃgamaheśvaraḥ yāvajjapati vīroyaṃ dūtiviśrāṃti hetave iththaṃ krameṇa viśrāṃtiṃ gatāyāṃ dūtikātanau caṃdrarekhārthāṃ gulinā pronnatā caṃdracaṃdrikā atasī puṣpasaṃkāśā trikoṇākāratāṃ gatā ciradravāpi nāthaika kluptairaṃguṣṭha cuṃbanaiḥ nābhaucapeṭa patanairnitaṃbe hastamardanaiḥ nijaṃrasaṃ sravaṃtyeva nāyikācaṃdracaṃdrikā paiṣṭimadyasamāmodaṃ bāṇapuṣpolbaṇadyuti prāptisiddhiprajananaṃ sarvaiśvaryākhyavāṅmayam samastavyādhiśamanaṃ laghuśītalanirmalam tadājapeditaṃ [kh: -japoditaṃ] maṃtraṃ ca palāṃbādhidaivatam

citte iti padaṃ procya reto muṃcadvayaṃ vadet evaṃ maṃtraṃ japanneva liṃgatāṃḍavamācaret sphuradgupigupitkāraṃ vimuṃcati parāmṛtam yamunāsalilairīśāḥ saṃśekaphalamaśnute datte paśupatatvaṃ ca yajamānamayīṃ sthitim sarveṣāmevamaṃtrāṇāṃ svayameva prakāśatā kavitvasya parākāṣṭhā rasasaubhāgyaśālinī pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca bhūtānāmiva [kh: -ha] sarvaśaḥ rasasiddhiṃ pādukāyāḥ siddhiṃ nidhyaṃjanaṃ [k: ni * janaṃ] tathā ākāśagamane caiva parakāya praveśane pratimācalane [kh: -cālane?] caiva bhūtavetāla vīkṣaṇe [kh: śīkṣaṇe] pāṭavaṃ paramaṃghatte [kh: -datte] saptamāhuti sādhakaḥ mahāliṃgamaheśāna svarasaiścāṃdracaṃdrikaiḥ saptakūpāraparyaṃta vāpikīrti vivardhanī [kh: vivarddhinī] etadāhuti velāyāṃ dūtikā va sthitiṃ bruve ānaṃda sukhasaṃbhārādati maṃtharatātanau [kh: maṃdhara-] mahānaṃdapayorāśau majjanaṃ tu kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ramaṇasyabhujā śleṣaṃ kiṃcit chlathanatā [kh: ślathanatā] tathā nitaṃbabiṃbakaṃ paścāt [kh: paśca] kāmacchatrasya narttanam vacovicchinna vicchinnapunaruktaṃ [kh: vicchinnaṃ-] ca bhūyasā asaṃbaṃdhārthanaṃ kiṃcit kiṃcicchuṣkaṃ ca rodanam alaṃ nātha namastubhyaṃ punasteracitoṃjaliḥ [kh: -rajitoṃjaliḥ] na sahebhavato vegaṃ na sahebhavatoratim kimarthaṃ māṃrasadroṇyāṃ majjayasyevanirghṛṇā khādāmi kiṃte sarvāṃgaṃ muṃcamāṃ muṃcavallabha

vivimocayamāṃ nātha cu cu cuṃbāmi me [kh: te] dhvajam huṃ huṃ huṃ dehi dehīti [kh: -tī] tyaktvāpallavacāruṇā [kh: tyuktvā-] saptamāhutisusnātaṃ liṃgamākṛṣya rāgiṇī cuṃbatī ca mukhe liṃgaṃ prāptasaptābhiṣecanam mukhe nikṣipyataṃ devaṃ daśanena vidaghnatī [kh: vidadhnatī] dhvajasya karṇikābhāgaṃ jihvayā [kh: jihvāyā] ca vilolayet pārśvoścanakharekhābhirurarī [kh: pārśve ca-] kurute ratim pibaṃtī [kh: -ti] vacataṃ nādaṃ [kh: -thaṃ] bahulīlāṃ samācaret atha caṃdrakalānāḍyāḥ [kh: -nāḍyā] svarūpaṃ kathayāmi te anekavarṇaśāvavre [kh: -śovavre] vibhūṣitanijākṛtiḥ atyaṃtaṃ mṛdulākāraṃ madhye kiṃcit sthalīyasi [kh: - sthavīyasi] yavākāramanuprāptā bhūyaḥ pulakitākṛtiḥ anyāsāmapi nāḍīnāṃ saptabhogasudhākirām samastānaṃda bharitā kāmālaṃbanayaṣṭikā ajarāmaratāhetu masyāvidrāvaṇakriyām navāsidheṣu [kh: sidhyeṣu] sādhyeṣu jānaṃti na varānane jaṃghayorapi jaṃghedve vakṣasyapi bhujāṃtaram adhare cāpi biṃboṣṭhaṃ nāsāyāmapi nāsikām sarvāṃgīṇamidaṃ nāma mardanaṃ parikīrtitam karṇamūlasirayugme [kh: -sirāyugme] sa cuṃbanaradakṣatam kiṃciddaśanadaṃśena cūcukadvaṃdva cūṣaṇam nābhīpuṭe phūtkaraṇaṃ bhrūmadhye cāpi sītkṛtiḥ āsanasya pradeśe ca maṃdaraṃ muṣṭitāḍanam etānyupācared vīro dūtikādrāvako bhavet pūrvokta [kh: -ktaṃ] cāpalaṃ maṃtraṃ bhagamālinikāmanum

kāmeśvarīmanuṃ caiva paṃcavidyāmanusmaret [kh: -manuṃsmaret] anenāpi ca yogena yadi sā na hi vidravet prāyuṃjīta vidhānena japannamṛtanāyikām ghaṭṭālīlakayāmātaḥ kṣobhayenmadanālayam [k: -nāla * m] tena dratyatīcīra dravācaṃdrakalāsirā atiguptamahāvidyā svarūpāḥ śailanaṃdinī yadi satyaṃ jagaddhātā paṃcakṛtyadharaḥ śivaḥ yadi satyaṃ samastānāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ gatirātmadṛk yadi satyaṃ ratiḥ kāmo vijayetetvayā jagat yadi satyaṃ dehabhājāṃ sarveṣāṃ sukhadaḥsmaraḥ [kh: -dasmaraḥ] yadi satyaṃ sudātvaṃ ca paramānaṃda dāyake yadi satyaṃ sarvapūjyā siṃhāsana maheśvarī yadi satyaṃ gurorājñā sarvatrāskhalitodayā ityaṣṭakārikāpāṭha samanaṃtarameva sā tenāmṛtena śuddhena śītalena laghīyasā [kh: -ghiyyasā] gaṃgodakasvarūpeṇa tarpayelliṃgapāvakam idaṃ yajña pradānāṃgamīyaṃ kaivalyapaddhatiḥ ātmavidyāphalaṃ caitadātmavidyāphalaṃ [kh: cetadā- -phala] tvidam tena saṃpūjitaścāsau bhīmatvaṃ tasya yacchati sabhaktaḥ paramākāśa rūponirmalatāṃgataḥ bhūmyādi sarvabhūtānāmavakāśa [kh: -nāṃ mava-] pradasvayam na puṇyairnna ca pāpaiśca na dharmādharmabhaṅgibhiḥ nāpakāropakāraiśca na dāridryavibhūtibhiḥ na ca baṃdhavimokṣābhyāṃ aspṛṣṭaścitsudhāmayaḥ gaṃdharva nagarākāramapi cānubhavatyataḥ

bahunākimihoktena sākṣādānaṃdadāyakaḥ iti dvitīyapātasya maṃtrasannāma īritam aṣṭabhogavatī dhatte mahāsāmrājya nāthatām [kh: nādhatām] sarvākāreṇa caitanya layaḥ sarvāṃgasuṃdarī [k: sundandarī] viśvakṣati [kh: -kṣiti] ca yatkiṃcinna ca niryāti vakrataḥ na ceṣṭā na ca saṃraṃbho na ca mohana kūjitam na daṃta pātanomuṣṭi ghātena [kh: ghātona] ca ka ca grahaḥ na mekhalā kalakvāṇo na līlāsaṃgamaṃgayaḥ [kh: -bhaṃgayaḥ] hṛdayasthāna janitaḥ kaṃpaḥ paraparāyate ekāṣṭakamahāyāga pakṣebiṃduṃ samutsṛjet aṣṭāṣṭakamahāyāge dūtyaṣṭakamataḥ param iyameva hi śakteśca śaṃbhorekatayā sthitiḥ itthamānaṃda [kh: iththa-] yāgo'yaṃ kathitaste maheśvari [kh: -rī] bhavato vadanāṃbhojāt suśruto'ṣṭāhuti kramaḥ śrotuṃ vāṃcchāmi deveśa yāgānaṃtarajaṃ kramam śṛṇu [kh: śruṇu] devi mahābhāge yanmāṃtvaṃ paripṛcchasi vīraḥ suciranṛttena śrāṃtaliṃgamaheśvaraḥ atha pradūṣita [kh: -te] pāte pūrite puṇyavastubhiḥ ānaṃdanāthasya manuṃcāṣṭāviṃśativārakam dakṣahastasya culuke dhārayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ saśuddhibhyāṃtayorbiṃduṃ kārikāḥ prapaṭhan kiret etairānaṃdayāgāṃta śuklaśoṇitabiṃdubhiḥ etairānaṃdayāgāṃta śuklaśoṇitabiṃdubhiḥ etairānaṃdayāgāṃta śuklaśoṇitabiṃdubhiḥ etairānaṃdayāgāṃta śuklaśoṇitabiṃdubhiḥ

etairānaṃdayāgāṃta śuklaśoṇitabiṃdubhiḥ etairānaṃdayāgāṃta śuklaśoṇitabiṃdubhiḥ etairānaṃdayāgāṃta śuklaśoṇita biṃdubhiḥ tarpayedakhilaṃ viśvaṃ svātmānaṃdamaheśvari [kh: -rī] athatāṃdūtikāmastaceṣṭāṃ niśvāsamātriṇīm [kh: vi -] ānaṃdamātranirmagnāṃ anivācye [kh: anirvācye] rase sthitām nābhimūlaṃ [kh: nābhī-] sakthimūlaṃ padapallavakomalam adhiskaṃdhaṃ patedasyā vidhāyakaramarddanāt viśeṣāt smaragehasya paritomṛdupāṇinā uttiṣṭhot tiṣṭhakalyāṇi yāgo'yaṃ caritārthakaḥ śirīṣadalahṛdyāni tavāṃgāni talodari [kh: -darī] kṣamasvatāni sarvāṇi bhūyo bodhamavāpnuyāt tadutthāya [kh: taduththāya] mahotsaṃga maṃgī kurvītibodhayet atyānaṃdāt pāravaśyaṃ [kh: pa-] vyaṃjatī nijavarṣmaṇā ahonānaṃda [kh: aho ānaṃda] sarvasvamanubhūtaṃ mayādhunā aholiṃgamaheśasya saṃtarpaṇamahāmakhaḥ ahotṛptāsmimattāsmi [kh: ahotṛptosmi-] caritārthāsmi bhūyasā ājanmamaraṇaṃ tvatkaṃ caraṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ mama svayaṃ gṛhasamāśleṣāṃ māmathāpyurarīkuru svayamapyayamāśliṣya vīrastāṃrajanīṃ [kh: vi-] nayet māhātmyaṃ sakalebhyo'pi kratubhyo'pyadhikaṃ phalam ratādhvarojīvanmuktirmahāhutiritīśvarī phalenibaddhabhāvānāmatyeṃdra padasaṃbhavaḥ iṃdrasyeṃdratvametena mahāyāgena suṃdari [kh: -rī] rudrasya rudrādhikṛtirjaleśatvaṃ pracetasaḥ

guptenānena mārgeṇa durgesamaraso bhavet kriyamāṇaḥ phalaṃ dhatte kṛtaśca phaladāyakaḥ ucyamāno'pi nudayā sahabādhnāti mitratām nānena sadṛśaṃ karma nānena sadṛśaṃ tapaḥ ayaṃ hi mokṣamārgāṇāmadhvāsulabha saṃcaraḥ guptādguptataraṃ karma guhyādguhyataraṃ tvidam durātmasudrācāreṣvati krodhāṃdhabuddhiṣu hitāhitānabhijñeṣu vṛthākalahakāriṣu [kh: vṛdhā-] akālajñeṣu mūrkheṣu harabhakti virodhiṣu ārūḍhapatiteṣvaṃba dīrgghasūtreṣu sādhiṣu malimluceṣu maṃdeṣu tuṃdumātrābhi poṣiṣu kutsiteṣu kuśīleṣu śaktidrohiṣu śaktiṣu cārvākamatalagneṣu devadrohakareṣu ca na praśyamidaṃ bhadre yāgarājamahāmṛtam daśayojanaparyaṃtaṃ sā puṇyā parikīrttitā kuladvaṃdvamanenaiva bhūṣitaṃ bhūdharātmaje yoṣitāṃ nayanānaṃda siṃdhūttaṃbhanacaṃdrikā bhṛṃgāṅganājavoddāma gītibaṃdhāśca kā sati ālokanenāsya paraṃ kṛtārthaṃ manyamānasāḥ vajradhārevaśakrasya parvateṣviha pārvati [kh: -tī] aṇimādiṣu saṃsiddhiṣva vipāṭava mṛcchati vahnarapyanuvarttinyo [kh: vahnera-] jātuṣyā iva putrikāḥ upāyanīkṛtya ca taṃ sevaṃte rājayoṣitaḥ parvatāneṣu kurvaṃti ye mahāyāgamuttamam araṇyamadhye ye yāgamarddharātreṣu kurvate

prāpya tatra balasthānaṃ dīptaratneṣu veśmasu tasmādidaṃ mahāyāgaṃ durllabhaṃ marutāmapi anyathākaraṇād [kh: anyadhā-] devī vinipātaḥ prajāyate prāmāṇike'smin suśroṇi mārgejīvati viśvasan maṃtre maṃtre tu karttavye bheṣaje daivate gurau vṛdhā] paśyaviśvāsamāhātmyaṃ śilādārumṛdādikam acetanaṃ jaḍadravyaṃ kena siddhiṃ prayacchati karmaśraddhā saṃpradāyā vubhāvetau [kh: -tā] pravarttakau sadāmalīmasā mūrkhāścaṃḍālādyāśca jātayaḥ nācāro na ca vā śaucaṃ na vaiduṣyaṃ na dhīguṇāḥ [kh: -ṇaḥ] viśvāso nāmamanaso dṛḍhatāmaṃtrasādhane evaṃ viśvāsamāpannaḥ phalārthiphalavigrahaḥ brāhmaṇakṣatriya viśāmadhikāro'traśāsanam vīraśuśrūṣaṇaṃ [kh: śusroṣaṇāṃ] teṣāmabhiṣṭaphalasiddhayaḥ vaiśyasya paṇyalābhārdhaṃ [kh: -rthāṃ] sudrādernakadācana ekaivajātirnārīti grāhyā [kh: grāhya] lakṣaṇasaṃbhave pūjāsādhanametā hi mayāsṛṣṭā mṛgīdṛśaḥ gāvastu pṛṣṭhatomedhyā medhyāvaktreṇa vādinaḥ [kh: vājinaḥ] strīmukhaṃ tu sadā śuddhirnocciṣṭaṃ [kh: -cchiṣṭhaṃ] tatra vidyate tābhirvinā na yajño'sti na tapo'stina vā vratam aṣṭāhutirmahāyāge pradhānaṃ dūtikāḥ [kh: -kā] smṛtāḥ ānīyaghaṭiyatyeṣā [kh: -ghaṭayatyeṣā] tasmād dūti [kh: -tī] prakīrtitā dūtī tena budhaiḥ [kh: vidhaiḥ] proktā ciṃtā saṃtāparodhinī bhoginībhogalakṣmīśca tasyāḥ paryāya sūktayaḥ

na prāpyate [kh: -ta] janaiḥ sarvairakṛtvā duṣkṛtaṃ tapaḥ tāsāṃ na kīrttayed doṣā na priyaṃtāsu saṃcaret yāṃ kāñcidapi [kh: kāṃcvidapi] dṛṣṭvā tu devatāmeva bhāvayet anyatra kāmacāraḥ [kh: -ra] syāt tāsumārdavamācaret jīrṇabhojenamātreyaḥ [kh: -bhojana-] kapilaḥ prāṇināṃdayām yāgakālaviyogepi [kh: -viyyogepi] nikaṭetāṃ niveśayet tayāvinā yadi japedanaṃgamadalolayā tasmādidaṃ mahāyāga māhātmyaṃ samudīritam māhātmyaṃ ca tvayā proktaṃ śrutaṃ śrotṛrasāyanam [kh: srotra-] ka-upāyo maheśāna [kh: -nā] raktāstāḥ khalusiddhitāḥ [kh: -dāḥ] anuraktābhiretābhiḥ kāryaṃ karmaṇi vidyate 119k) bahudoṣagrahagrastāḥ kauṭilyopahatāśayāḥ atropāyaṃ vadeśāna śuśrūṣitamidaṃ mama striyaḥ [kh: -ya] svabhāva capalāḥ [kh: -lā] bahudoṣaparigrahāḥ kiṃciccitte [kh: kiṃcit citte ] mukhe kiṃcit kiṃcillocana veṣṭite bahumāyākalāvatyo bahunāyakalaṃpaṭāḥ nānāvidhena bhāvena tuccānāṃ [kh: tucchānāṃ] tu mṛgīdṛśām puruṣasyaikabhāvasya [kh: -syeka-] śuddhasphaṭikasannibhaḥ raktā iva viraktāḥ [kh: -ktā] syuḥviraktā [kh: syur-] iva cotsukāḥ śastrapāṇinām natairbahuvidhaiḥ patyā [kh: prītyā] pūritā apyanukṣaṇam na bhogena na vittena nāvirodhanivedanāt sveduḥkhena [kh: kheduḥkhena] nipīḍyaṃte sukhaṃ teṣāṃ niraṃtaram nirmānuṣepi vipine sthāpitāḥ śaradāṃśatam nārīṇāmiva vidyānāṃ mukhaṃ kairnābhicuṃbitam

parirabhya tu bhartāraṃ kvaṇat kaṃkaṇadorlatāḥ na brahmaṇā na śakreṇa na mayā na ca viṣṇunā api prākāraśatakairanukṣaṇa surakṣitāḥ strīṇāṃ duḥsilakaraṇe [kh: duḥśīla-] paravyāmohane'pi ca kenāpi na gṛhastāsāṃ cittasyātī [kh: -ti] valolataḥ na pūtirmanasaḥ [kh: pūrttirmma-] kvāpi na tṛptiḥ kvāpikarmaṇi anyamanyaṃ ciṃtayaṃto gūḍhābhiprāyaceṣṭitāḥ na tu tāsāṃ manoglāniḥ prāṇaparyaṃta sāhasaiḥ nāgnistṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ nāpagānāṃ [kh: -nā] mahodadhiḥ strīṇāṃ dviguṇamāhāro buddhiścāpi caturguṇam mahāyāga prasaṃgena proktaṃ kāmāṣṭakaṃ mayā tasmādala [kh: tasmādarala] dṛṣṭīnāṃ marālacikurabhruvām tāsāṃ yadi manopuṃsi kutrāpi parilipyate [k: * * * * *] na ca dravati bhogāṃbu na ca vibhramasaṃpadaḥ tasmānmanaḥ paraṃ vakṣya manyato hariṇīdṛśām sauṃdaryavibhramālāpa saukhyaśṛṃgārasaṃpadaḥ avahiththāvaśenaiva parapūruṣalolatā mūḍhāstabdhā na jānaṃti bhāvaṃ kṛtrimaceṣṭitam aho mūḍhena durllakṣyaṃ strīṇāmākṛticeṣṭitam vaṃcakānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vaṃcakā vamalocanā api śāstravivettāraṃmapi [kh: -rāmapi] śāstreṇa laṃpaṭāḥ api rajjupraharaṇamapi rakṣaṇadakṣiṇam apyuddhatamapi kṛddhamapi coramapiprabhum [kh: -bhiprabhum] yastrīṇāṃ hṛdayavyālagrahaṇe [k: * davyāla-] cāhituṃḍikaḥ vīrasyeva prakṛṣṭena samācāreṇajāyate

vīreṇa tāsu karttavyo heturaṃjanahetavaḥ ācāryamāṇairyastrīṇāṃ ananyaśaraṇaṃ manaḥ skhalaneṣu titikṣā [kh: titīkṣā] ca doṣasya punarīkṣaṇam daṇḍanītirnna tu strīṣu prapātayitu marhati paśyasāhasametāsāṃ svargate nijabharttari khedatāḍanapāruṣyairmuṃcantyeva [kh: -cyatyeva] svajīvitam ataścamārdavaṃtāsu prathamaṃ cittaraṃjanam atyaṃtamabhivṛddhiṃ ca nayaccettāsusādhakaḥ [kh: -cchettāsu-] madhyamena prakāreṇa [k: pra * * *] darśanaṃ [k: * * *] pradiśidbudhaḥ raktaḥ [k: raka] parebhavaṃ [kh: pari-] yāti paribhūtaḥ kathaṃ priye vṛṣasyaṃtīṣu tāsvaṃba na vai mukhyaṃ ca cārayet grāsānapi ca vāsāṃsi yathā śakti nivedayet tasmād vīrajanādhīnā dūtikā prakṛti [kh: -tiḥ] śive daṃpatyorghaṭanaṃ brūyat puruṣārthaikakāraṇam anyonyamanurāgeṇa mahatsaukhyaṃ prajāyate tasmāt tadānukūlyāya svānukūlyaṃ prakāśayet āliṃganacchalenaiva sukhaṃ [kh: sukha] saṃvāhanaṃ caret ādāyalimpeccaraṇe dūtyāḥ sā nānyagābhavet jugupsamāno na bhavedvairāgyaṃ tena jāyate satilokeṣu [kh: nati-] saṃcāramutsavaṃ ca pade pade vividaiḥ [kh: vividheḥ] sarasaiḥ pakvaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ udvarttanaiścatāṃbūlairaṃjanairmukhavāsitaiḥ raṃjayedramaṇīṃ [kh: -ṇiṃ] dhīmānbhogairdīptaiśca pārvati [kh: -tī] tāvaddhiramanā eva bhogabhedā tu [kh: nu] pācaret ślāghayājāyate tacca sadarpāviphalāstriyaḥ

avaśyamanuraktatvaṃ janayanti mṛgīdṛśaḥ sadā japati [k: jyapanti] ye śyāmāṃ kadaṃbavanavāsinīm nityaklinnāṃ navā devīṃ navātāṃ [kh: -taṃ] bhagamālinīm athavā bālikāṃ devī [kh: -vīṃ] japanvaśayati striyaḥ sadā kāmakalārūpaṃ dhyāyenmūrddhaniyoṣitām athavā svaṃvapurdhyātvā rāgapravatasannibham tatraiva sarvanārīṇāṃ kaṃtarpanilayāṃtarāt anena dhyānayogena vahnayagre [kh: vahnyā?gre] navanītavat athavānijamākāraṃ dhyāyenmadanagopavat udayattapanaprakhyamurjjitaṃ kāṃtisaṃpadām digaṃrābhiḥ prasyaṃdayonibhinna svamūrttibhiḥ śṛṃgārarasamattābhiḥ pulakāṃcitamūrttibhiḥ īṣatkaṭākṣaṃ vikiretyuccalaccāṭucārubhiḥ piṃcchāvataṃ sasukhadaṃ premārdrakalabhāṣaṇam locanaiḥ sasmitākūtaiḥ pītagopāṃganādṛtim tato vaśayatikṣipraṃ dhārayaṃtiṃ śivāśrayet āsurīrapi [kh: āsarīrapi] gaṃdharvīryakṣi [kh: -kṣīḥ] siddhavilāsinīḥ lalitā dhyānayogena vṛddhopimadanāyate paśyaṃti lalitākārā nāryaḥ kāmamivāparam lalitājapanadhyānaiḥ [kh: -nai] strīṇāṃ bhavati vallabhaḥ anyathā [kh: anyadhā] viphalaṃ tasya ratādvarasamarccanam [kh: -dhvara-] strīṇāṃ vyavasthā sarvāsāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ vyavasthitiḥ caturāśīti lakṣāṇijātayaḥ saṃprakīrttitāḥ asyāḥ [kh: asyā] striya amuṣyāstu bhartāyamiti śaṃkara jāti sāmyena ye dharmāste dharmā narajātiṣu

dharmādharmavyavasthā ca vedaśāstrādiḍaṃbaraḥ atrakāraṇamatyarthaṃ niścityabrūhi cinnidhe sarvāsāmapi jātīnāṃ jagdhiyābdhisuṣuptayaḥ etat hetukaṃ devī hetustatra nigadyate iṣṭasādhanataṃtrajñāḥ [kh: -jñā] na sarvatrāpi jātiṣu pakṣīṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ svāhāre potapoṣaṇam āyāṃti daṇḍahastaṃ tu dṛṣṭvāmithyā [kh: -bhītyā] pravarttate gamaḥ] kathaṃ jñānasya rāhityaṃ varttate girinaṃdini [kh: -nī] paśvāderapi bodhastu manuṣyavadudīkṣyate tathā hi cuṃcugrastaistu tṛṇairnidaṃvinirmati [kh: -niḍaṃvinirmati] aṃtargupta pradeśatvaṃ varṣavātānupadravam tatra paṃkalavelagne khadyate [kh: khadyote] niśibhāsvare pakṣiṇī [kh: -ṇā] bhogasahitaḥ pakṣīnirviśatidṛvam [kh: -dhruvam] ātānaṃ ca vitānaṃ ca tat jñānaṃ nādhikānnatām [kh: -konnatām] nivedayati suśroṇi svajāti gatapāṭavam ekarūpāṇi cakrāṇi stālagrāmeṣu [kh: sāla-] tanvataḥ brahmaṇāpi [kh: braṃhaṇāpi] na tacchakyaṃ pratijātīdṛśīgatiḥ rātrāvulūka [kh: -pulūkaḥ] suśroṇi ghaṭādīnpratipadyate anyajāteraśakyaśca varttate varavarṇini [kh: -nī] varṇayiṣyati tadvādo vṛthāsaṃbhūtaḍaṃbaraḥ [kh: vṛdhā-] āhāraṃ caiva nidrā ca bhayaṃ maithunameva ca sarvadaika svarūpā syurjātayomartyavarjitāḥ kṛte saṃpūrṇadharmāḥ [kh: -rmā] syuḥsarve pārvati mānavāḥ bhavaṃti ca vilīyaṃte [kh: viliyyaṃte] pratāyaṃte punaḥ punaḥ

yathā [kh: yadā] dharmeṇa tiṣṭhaṃti kṛtādi samaye narāḥ navā klabyaṃ navādainyaṃ na dhairyaṃ na ca matsaraḥ etepi doṣā na kṛte puṇyarāśiḥ [kh: puṇyā-] pravarddhate [k: * * * *] tatrakevalamadhyātma ciṃtārthaṃ [k: -rdaṃ] svasvaśaktiṣu tadā [kh: tathā] paśūnāṃ vyāvṛttirūhāpohavivarjjitā tasminkṛtādisamaye yannije cetase [kh: -si] sthitam ata eva samācārastisṝṇāmapi pārvati anāvṛtāḥ [kh: -tā] striyaḥ sarvāḥ [kh: sarvās] tadāsan svairavṛttayaḥ yadā kadācit puṇyārthamapatyārthaṃ pravarttate tatrāpatyaṃ samutpādya nijavāṃchāṃ prapūrayan upabhuktāmaye yaṃ stritya [kh: stri *] abhimāno na kaścana samastajāti sāmyena tadā sarve sthitānarāḥ araṇyorvyāmivoddīptau rāgadveṣa hutāśanau yat samasteṣu martyeṣu svabhāvādupajāyate rāgadveṣa mahādāvadahyamāna itastataḥ dvāparādyeṣu kāleṣu rāgadveṣa vimūrchitaḥ [kh: vimūrcitaḥ] mamaivasakalābhūmi [k: -lamūmi] viṣayatvena tiṣṭhatu mamaiva sakalānārīrati karmaṇi tiṣṭhatu ato'sya śāsanaṃ kāryameṣaduṣṭo nihanyatām imaṃ tu durbalaṃ hatvā bhogān bhuṃje manoharān anyonyakalahaṃ kṛtvā paraspara vimardanaiḥ nivārakonako'pyasti sarvepyuddāna buddhayaḥ na mūrdhnodeha pīḍāṃvānātmaśṛṃgasya moṭanam vṛthādveṣeṇa [kh: vṛdhā-] kinnāśaṃ vyayaṃyāma iti priye ato'nyonyasya hananamanyonyasya ca māraṇam

triklabāśayāḥ] varṇāśrama vyavasthāṃ ca niyamāṃśca śarīriṇām [kh: -ṇam] dharmaśāstraismṛtiḥ śāstrairācārasya pravarttanam prativarṇāśramaṃ caiva bhinnabhinnā vyavasthitiḥ paradāraprasaṃgeṣu yathā varṇaṃ [kh: vaṇṇa] ca daṇḍanam yataḥ prajāmanodoṣa nivṛtyaidaṇḍakalpanam [kh: -kalpanā] sāmabhedaudānadaṇḍaupyupāyā viśvarakṣaṇe tenaiva vyapadeśo hi sarvasya nayavartmanaḥ prajādoṣasya bāhulyāta dvyapekṣā [k: dyapekṣā] tu bhūyasī [kh: -si] evaṃ kṛtena mārgeṇa maryādā kalpanātmanaḥ varttaṃta eva citteṣu doṣāste tu hinātmaje manvādikṛtaśāstrāṇi pramāṇīkṛtyabhūrayaḥ teṣāṃ bhaya bhaṭaśreṇi dvīpasādhanasaṃpadām rājādyagocarāṇāṃ tu keṣāmapi tanūbhṛtām yamadaṇḍādi śāstrāṇya pramāṇī kṛtyavallatām [kh: -valgatām] rājadaṇḍabhayādeke yamadaṇḍabhayātpare uttamā madhyamā nīcāḥ [kh: -cās] tasmin kāledha'māḥ dhamāḥ teṣāṃ krameṇa sarveṣāṃ cittadoṣanivāraṇe tatra sāmopadeśasya lakṣaṇaṃ saṃpracakṣmahe rāgaṃ tyajati sarvatrasvaiva bhāryāvalaṃbatām ātmīye naiva [kh: neva] labdhena vastunā hṛditṛptatā [kh: -taptatā] vidyāṃbhajata sācārāḥ śuddhasvātmavimṛṣṭaye iththaṃ gṛhīta dharmārthā vimṛśyanvātmanodhiyā tanmūlaṃ ca mahāduḥkhaṃ vimṛśyanyāyamasthitā bhedopadeśamārgeṇa vyādiśannaramadhyamān [kh: -madyamān]

śṛṇu [kh: śruṇu] te tadvacomatkaṃ bhobho puruṣamadhyamāḥ ātmabhūmau ca tiṣṭhaṃtāṃ satsusviyyeṣu [k: sat * svīyeṣu] vastuṣu astirāmonāmahansūryavaṃśe mahīpatiḥ tamanvagāyayaurāmamanujo dharmaśālinam tayā ca sahitorāmaḥ kaniṣṭhena ca kānane karṇā karṇikayā karṇyasītāṃ [kh: karṇyā -] saundaryaśālinīm samūlonmūlito saṃkhye [kh: jajñe] rāghaveṇaikacāriṇā parabhūmi prasaktiśca natvayātāṃ [kh: satva-] kvacit kvacit ekākī pādacārī ca gṛdhrāṇāmabhavadbaliḥ etādṛśavinīpātamagamaddhṛtarāṣṭrajaḥ nikṣipasvamihācāramanuniṣṭhagatajvaraḥ bhetopadeśanirbhiṇāścittadoṣa [kh: -rbhinnāścitta-] nirāgrahāḥ atha nīca narāṇāṃ tu dānarūpopadeśataḥ dānaṃ nāmeṣṭavastūnāṃ satyāsatyasvarūpiṇām tatra vyāsādayaḥ procurevaṃ nīcanarānprati paradārānuṣaṃ gācca viratyā [kh: -tyāt] puṇyasaṃpadaḥ paravastu grahaṇato nirutyā [kh: nirantyā] saṃpadudbhavet anena puṇyamārgeṇa tava saukhyaṃ pade pade samāpsyasi vipralobhya sadācārān vyāsādhyātānvininvire [kh: -dyātānvininyire] tīvropavāsa [k: * * * *sa] duḥkhādyamapi kurvaṃti mānavāḥ atodānopadeśo'yaṃ nicamartyeṣu coditaḥ bahudoṣagrahavatāṃ kakṣyātraya vilaṃghinām teṣu tanmārgamālambya śikṣayantyadhamādhamān hastacchedaiḥ padacchedaiḥ [kh: -dais] tāḍanaiḥ sūcivedhanaiḥ

sudarśanaprakāraiśca jihvāśravaṇakarttanaiḥ todanaiḥ pīḍanaiścaiva tadāsye dhūlipūraṇaiḥ anayādaṇḍitāḥ sarve sadūramadhamādhamāḥ anyasya striyamālokya kasyanovikṛtammanaḥ vicārayati daṇḍena vimṛśatyātmanolayam evaṃ catvāra uktāye tadupāyāmanīṣiṇaḥ manvādikṭamaryādālaṃghanaṃ na vitanvate ānaṃdanātha pūjā tu sarvajātisamā priye sarvasādhāraṇaścāpi mahāyogomaheśvarī tiraścāṃ tu mahāyāge tṛṇabhakṣādivatparam tatrāpi ye narāduṣṭāḥ paśuvanmūrkhavṛttayaḥ ye vīrāgurumaṃtaśca niḥsaṃdehā dṛḍhavṛtāḥ yairevapatanaṃ loke vīrastaireva siddhyati pānādivastu jātānāṃ rūpaṃ na niyataṃ kvacit ayastu paṇḍitaṃloke jalekṣiptaṃ nimajjati tasmānnavastuto vastu [k: * *] yat kiṃcinniyataṃ kvacit iti tvatpṛṣṭhamākhyātaṃ sarvaṃ sarvāṃgasundari [kh: -rī] pipṛcchiṣā punastvanyākācidastimamāśaye tadyeka eva sarvasya śāstravastuniyāmakaḥ kimidaṃ śāstrabhedena buddhivibhramavaiśasam adhruvatvamathovakti satyatvaṃ jagatoparaḥ paramāṇu svarūpatvamanyovadati [kh: -manovadati] śaṃkara [kh: śa-] kasyavāśaṃ karamate tātvikatvamahaṃstuve sarvatra bhinnamokṣāśca bhinnāḥ sarvatra ca kriyāḥ kasiṃśca darśane deva yat puṇyatvena kīrttitam

tatrāpi hetavastīvrāḥ [kh: -vrā] bhūyasyoyuktayo'pi ca vyāmohe jāyate dūraṃ tayorālokanānṛṇām sthāne pṛṣṭhaṃ tvayādevi samyage tadvivicyate na kevalaṃ dhīvilāso vaikharyapi ca kāraṇam saṅkalpena vikalpena narajātyekavāsinā teṣāṃ tu darśanānāṃ yo vedaḥ prathamadarśanam tatrodāsīna vṛttīnicānyāni parameśvarī na tu viśrāṃti vārttāpi kasyacidvādavartmanaḥ [kh: -cidvātha-] rucināmiha vai citryād [kh: citryā] bahudhāśāstrakoṭayaḥ arthaśāstraṃ ca suśroṇi tābhyāṃ śāstrasamudgamaḥ pratyakṣādi pramāṇāni sarvathā [kh: -dhā] kāraṇaṃ tvidam kasyāpi samatā devi [kh: -vī] trividhoyaṃ pramākramaḥ saugatāścaiva kāṇādā pratyakṣānumitījaguḥ nyāyaika deśinaścānye sāṃkhyavat [kh: sāṃkhyā-] samudīritāḥ arthāpatyā sahaitāni catvāryapara ūcire saṃbhavaitīha yuktaistaiḥ ṣaḍbhirmānaiśca kecana atrāntarbbhāvamanyonyaṃ vādinoyuktapaṇḍitāḥ bhūyaḥ parigraho [kh: -he] yasya yasya svalpaparigrahaḥ ye kurvantī [kh: kurvaṃti] hamanvānāḥ śāstreṣvalpaparigraham teṣāṃ mataṃ ca dhūnvānāstarka granthibhirujvalaiḥ [kh: graṃddhi-] evaṃ sati samasteṣu śāstreṣu kalahaṃ [kh: -ha] kramaḥ āropajaṃ nirasyaṃti kecit svarasavādinaḥ āropasya svarūpantu kathayāminagātmaje mṛttikākhalu sarveyaṃ bhūmirnnānāvidhākṛtiḥ etat bhūmī [kh: -mi] mṛttikaivakuṃbhakṛtpāṇimardditā

atho sa eva mṛtpiṇḍaṃ kulālakaravarttanaiḥ gabhīrite madhyadeśe tatraiva kuharīkṛtaḥ kuṃbha ityasya śabdasya vācyatāmavagāhate bhūmau viśīrṇa sarvāṃgaḥ kāpālaugha tvamīhate [k: -ha *] kuṭṭitaḥ sanprabhajate dhūliśabdasya vācyatām śīrṇaśīrṇaḥ punarvegāttra [kh: -gātra] sareṇutvamicchati atyaṃta sūkṣmadurlakṣā ghūrṇate vāyumaṇḍale anyonyaśabdanirvācyāsta āropāḥ [kh: -pa] prakīrttitāḥ tatrāropitarūpatvaṃ [k: -ro * * * * *] ghaṭādeḥ kārayanbudhaḥ guṇāntarasamāsaṃga mātrādevakathaṃ mṛdi vṛthā [kh: vṛdhā] tasya samāropaṃ vṛthā [kh: vṛdhā] tasya punarlayaḥ īdṛśā eva kalahe hetavaḥ pratipāditāḥ varṇātmakāstu ye śabdāstatra nityatvamekakaḥ ataḥ pravṛddhavairāṇāṃ vādināmabhivalgatām prabhūtataradarpāṃdhāḥ pāṇḍitya grahadurdhiyām tadgaveṣaṇamārgeṇa tat samāna samādhinā viruddhabhāṣaṇe jāti nigraha sthānakalpanaiḥ paścātkope sati galoccoṣakāraṇa [kh: -cchoṣakāraṇa] ghoṣaṇaiḥ punastena prakāreṇa keśākeśi [kh: -śī] kṛte raṇe pādāt saṃvṛtavegānāṃ vādināṃdveṣaveśmasu siddhāntitaiśca svamanaḥ śuddhairanyaiśca ninditaiḥ vyāmūḍhān kurvatāmeṣa teṣāṃ panthāniraṅkuśaḥ [kh: pandā-] pramāṇāṃdhāḥ ṣoḍaśāye padārthaistairmahākālīḥ [kh: -kariḥ] kalahaḥ kevalaṃ tatra duḥsamāpaśaracchataiḥ [kh: -daiḥ] saṃprāptirūpo bhavitā tadā vāmena nirṇayaḥ

vivecanīye [kh: -niyye] saṃprāpte vāda eva pravarttate vādasya tu samāpto hi jātinigrahasiddhidā anyonyāśraya doṣeṇa tena vādena darśanam parasparavyāhatāni na camatkārakāṇinaḥ anyonyamapramāṇatva khyāti vipramapattayaḥ [kh: viprati-] pramitānya parastatra pramāṇyaṃ nāvabudhyate sannikṛṣṭārtha [k: -kṛṣṇarda] rūpatvaṃ tatra madhyastha dṛkprabhā tadvādi prativādyukta yuktipāṇḍitya tatvavit āyāta vādinaḥ sarve teṣāṃ ca prativādinaḥ doṣoguṇaścaiva samoradhraṃ cāpi samaṃ smṛtam naikaḥ paryanuyoktavyaḥ tādṛgarthavicāraṇe ataḥ sāmya pradhānānāṃ [k: pradā * *] na [k: *] dveṣonyatra yujyate yat kiṃcit karmayā kāciddevatā yaccakiṃcana yaḥ kopi mokṣaḥ sarvatra śāstre sadṛśa īritaḥ etat prakāratā pattau bhavatastu vyadhātkaliḥ sarveṣvapi ca śāstreṣu jñānamānaṃdalakṣaṇam vicāryamāṇenāstaiva [kh: -nāsyaiva] sarvavyavahṛtā vadhi jñānamānaṃdarūpaṃ tat sarvagaṃ sarvajātikam iti madhyastarūpasya svātmānaṃdamaheśi tuḥ tatheti pratipadyaṃte śāstraiḥ sahanijairnnavaiḥ aṃgatāṃ kilayātāni śāstrāṇi vividhānyapi praveśaḥ kramataḥ pūjyāścārvākādinijāgamāḥ yāni yānyantarasthāni tānitā vudbalāni [kh: yud-] vai parivārārakṣakāśca guptyardāḥ [kh: -rthāḥ] śāstra saṃcayāḥ śāstramārgabhavantyeva [kh: -mārgā-] vīramārgasya cāṅgatām

puruṣārthastu mukhyoyo mahāyāgopapādakaḥ ānaṃdayogo hi paramatastat pratisādhakaḥ dharmaḥ khalu mahāyāgo dṛṣṭādṛṣṭa [kh: dṛṣṭhā-] phalapradaḥ sa eva mākṣopi śive parānaṃdamayatpataḥ dharmarūpī kāmarūpī mokṣarūpī ca pūruṣaḥ dhanaṃkhalu maheśasya pūjāprathamasādhanam nātyaṃta saurabhaṃ vastu na vā sūkṣmataraḥ paṭaḥ na phalāni ca hṛdyāni na pakvāni phalāni ca dhanaṃ vinā na sidhyaṃti [kh: vināṃbasidhyanti] puruṣārthaḥ sa īritaḥ sa [kh: na] tu śāstrāṇi sarvāṇi nirarthānyapi nātyajat [kh: -jan] tarkādiśāstrābhyāsasya dhanadāyānidānatām nānyajāti juṣojaṃtorāhārya [kh śṛṣojaṃto-] sulabhatvataḥ narajātiriyantvetaiḥ saṃskṛtairātmapoṣiṇī duṣkaraṃ cāpi kaṃcodyat paraspara gaveṣaṇam atikaṣṭhataraṃ devi [kh: devī] bahuduḥkhaikabhājanam vīrāṇāṃ svātmapūjārtha dhanasaṃpādanāya ca tadāpyamīgirisute [kh: tathāpya-] paravyāmoha hetave ahaṃ vedārtha tatvajño yajñavidyākṣamosmyaham ṣaḍaṅgavedatatvajña stvahameva mahītale ābrahmaśuddhadāro'hamahamasmyā [kh: -smtyā] hi tuṇḍikaḥ ahṃ nādyarasajñosmi [kh: nāḍhya-] kāvyālāpeṣvahaṃ paṭuḥ iti garvoddhatairvākyaiḥ satyāsatya [kh: satyāḥ-] vimiśritaiḥ dhaninomohadarpāṃdhā arcayaṃte vasubhiścataiḥ kevalaṃ jagdhiyabdhyarthe mūrkhāḥ samadhicinvate te tu tat tacchāstraniṣṭhāḥ pūjanārthaṃ dhanārjakāḥ

guptārthāya [k: gurpardāya] ca hṛdyāṅgi na tu tatvāvabodhane ānaṃdataṃtra evāsminnā paratra kvacinmataḥ tatvabhūtamidaṃ subhruyo mahāyāga īritaḥ asya taṃtrasya tatvāni siddhāntaśca pradarśyate [kh: -daśyate] āvirbbhāvatirobhāvau varttete sarvavastuṣu na devadatto bhavanānnirgacchan pūrvasaṅgataḥ na devadatto bhavanāt praveśanatirohitaḥ āvirbhāvaṃ vinotpattiranyākāpina vidyate tadvicāre kṛte naiva cārutvamanudhāvati utpannatvaṃ viśiṣṭatvaṃ tadaivādau [kh: tathai-] pradarśitam na tu teṣāṃ vāstavatvaṃ vyavahāraikajanmanā diśaścacarcane deśo nabhasaścarcane marut bhūmirāponalo vāyuḥ śabdaścatimiraṃ manaḥ etad bhidaiva sarveṣāṃ padārthānāṃ vijṛmbhaṇam saṅghatarūpakarmādyā na teṣāmasti gaṇyatā maruccatimirannaiva saṃścayaṃ [kh: saṃśrayaṃ] kvacidarhataḥ navadravyāṇi caitāni kīrttitāni mahāgame eteṣāmeva bhedena nānāsaṃkhyāṃ [kh: nanā-] vidhāya ca pratyakṣamānānubhavaḥ sarveṣveteṣu pārvati [kh: -tī] jaladhvānte śuklānile bhūśuciḥ śabalākṛti sparśaḥ [kh: sparśa] pratyakṣaviṣayaḥ pavanaḥ parvatātmaje manojīvavaśāḥ sarve pratipannāḥ [kh: -nnā] svayaṃ pramāḥ tatra śabdastvāptavāco vedavidyāgamātmakaḥ viśiṣṭabhāge sādṛṣṭe darśanaṃ bhāginoyataḥ dṛṣṭasarvasvarūpasya ghaṭasyādhyakṣatāsthi [kh: -dyakṣatāsthi] cet

dṛṣṭa sarvā kṛtitvasya ghaṭanaṃ na ghaṭe bhavat [kh: bhavet] tritvantu vyavahārasyāpyapekṣaivātra sammatam navamaṃ śivatatvaṃ tu śabdabhāvyamihādhunā śabdabhāsyatvamujhitvā svādhyakṣeṇa sabhāsate svāśrayo marudekasya [kh: mara-] udāsīnaṃ tamaḥ [kh: tama] smṛtam śivastu sarvāśrayaḥ [kh: -ya] syāt tatra samyagvivicyate mahyāṃ [kh: mahyaṃ] siddhādirūpeṇa vāyaumeghahimātmatā śabdemaṃghījalamarut [kh: -maṃdhījala-] saṃśrayaḥ kathitaḥ priye saṃghātaśca pṛthivyādeḥ [kh: -de] śarīratvena kīrtyate prāṇena ceṣṭamānaṃ yat tat sacit kamihocyate manaḥsaṃsrayaṇaṃ prāṇi sacit kavapuṣismṛtam sarveṣāmihatatvānāṃ vikṛtirguṇabhedajā saṃghātajāśca saṃghātā bahavonaikarūpiṇaḥ bahunā kimihoktena kintatvairaparairjaḍaiḥ acchedyo'yamadāhoya makledyośoṣya eva ca sarvaviśvasya janakaḥ [kh: -ka] sarvaviśvasya pālakaḥ sa giridvīpajaladhikānanā sakalāmahī [kh: -mahi] etā dṛśyastva saṃkhyātā vasudhāvāsavārcite jyotiścakraṃ samastaṃ ca vāyu naiva pracālyate sadā carati kutrāpi sadā ca sthimitaḥ kvacit yadā pravahati kṣipraṃ saśabdena tatodyate etat tu tattvaṃ kathitamasyaivānyā vibhūtayaḥ tat tacchāstra sthitiḥ sarvā kathitā girinaṃdini [kh: -nī] anyatra mama yat kiṃcit praṣṭavyaṃ spṛṣṭamāśaye aneka jantujālena nibiḍasya nirantaram

vicitrairjātibhedaiśca vastubhiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ kutra vā tiṣṭhati vibho kinnaśyati na naśyati vividhairmatabhedairmedhī vyāmohaḥ pravarttate tvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya na cchettā kopiśaṃkara punarṇavanavākāraṃ pratnamapyavabhāsate śarīrameva kasyāpi puṃsoviśvābhimāninaḥ te te bhāvāstatsamānā jagaddhe he vyavasthitāḥ gurutvalaghutātvaṃ ca na bhedastvaṃḍapiṇḍayoḥ [k: bhedvastvaṇḍa-] piṇḍayoḥ [k: paṃḍayoḥ] pravāhanityatā pāde tā dṛgevāṇḍagocaraḥ na nūtanaṃ pūrvamapisvaṃ pūrvākāramāśritam 160k) kṣaṇikatvavidhoye tu mūrkhāste parikīrttitāḥ tat pūrvākāratā garbhastat pūrvākāratorasaḥ tat pūrvākāratā bījaṃ tat bījākāratauṣadhiḥ athānyopi pravāho me vākyā devāvabudhyatām tat pituḥ pūrvarūpantu tat pitā tat pituḥ paraḥ pravāhāvayavākāra bhedenāpi ca nityatā yato'vayavi saṃghāto'vayavitvena gaṇyate yadi saṃdṛśyate kvāpi tatra śabdaikarūpatā iyamevagatiḥ [kh: -ti] sthūle viśvacakrepi yujyate tanniṣekasya sāmarthyāt tat patnīśoṇitairapi utpādite devadatto tadā tadvajjagat priye māruteśvara sampanna saṅkalpakṣaya īritaḥ tadāṇḍarūpatā pattireṣā sṛṣṭiḥ samīritā saṃyojayati bhūtāni viyojayati [kh: viyyojayadi] ca prabhuḥ

svataṃtra svaira saṃcāro nāsyādhikyena kaṃcana [kh: -nā] tadeva rūpaṃ saṃdhatte vāyurevamahābalaḥ [kh: -reṣa-] etadaṇḍa purāvasthā tadaṇḍāntaramīritam jantudehāntare yadvat sirāstadvanmahāpagāḥ tathāṇḍamadhye suśroṇi bhātibhānuḥ pradīptimān yathā kvacit sirākoṇe malakośonnakośake yathāntargatakīṭānāṃ vṛttāntonaśarīriṇau [kh: -ṇā] dehānurūpa saṃceṣṭo yathā dehābhimānavān ata ātyantikonāśo naiva piṇḍāṇḍayorbhavet kīṭādya pekṣayā yadvat paśyatāṃcirajīvitā [kh: -nāṃci-] nṛṇāmapekṣyā yadvat siddhānāṃ cirajīvitā [kh: ciraṃ-] mahāśaṃbhoriti yathā kramād [kh: kramā] dīrghāyuṣa sthitiḥ tat tad dehatataiḥ sāraiścirāciranivāsitā kākādīnāṃ śarīreṣu cirajīvimaheśvaraḥ 162k) yathā yathā nirmalatāṃ bhūta saṃghāta īhate taccanairmalyameṇākṣi tathā pākena jāyate sa cāpyaniyataḥ subhru kvacid bhavati na kvacit kaścit pūrvādhikojanmi guṇaiḥ sarvaiśca saṃyutaḥ śāṃbhavopāya saṃsiddha śāktānavavivarjitaḥ marudvaśamahābhūta pākasyaiṣa parākramaḥ trailokyatimiradhvaṃsi bhāskarākhyaṃ mahāmahaḥ sthānāt sthānāntara prāptyācalanaṃ tena pārvati [kh: -tī] tadādeḥ kāraṇaṃ vāyurevaṃ hartāsamīraṇaḥ anyonyabhautikāṃśānāṃ na yajjanma ca janminaḥ yatnena ghaṭitaṃ rūpaṃ svena yat saṃhariṣyate [kh: -viṣyate]

vṛddhiṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe kurvan yat pālayati janminaḥ sarvaṃ viśvasyabhūyopi [kh: viśvasva-] viśvametaccarācaram sa [kh: sva] śeṣamātraḥ pravahan svātmanyeva samīraṇaḥ yadā [kh: yadā] bhūmyādi viśleṣaṃ kṛtvā cāsya samīraṇaḥ evaṃ prakārato devi [kh: devī] paṃcakṛtya prapaṃcakaḥ nityaṃśarīravāṃścaiva [kh: śarī * vāṃścaiva] nānāśastasya vidyate ata icchā kriyājñāna śaktisaṃghaṭṭarūpiṇam prāṇākāreṇa viśati sarvāṃścaiva samīraṇaḥ samānākāratā panno vācaṃ vyavaharan svayam samānatāṃ gataḥ sarvaṃ vyāpayatyaśanaṃ tanau jagadeka viharttā sau khelatyakhilabhairavaḥ parāgābahavo bhānti tathā vāteṇḍakoṭayaḥ sarvaṃ vāyu vaśaṃ jñeyaṃ na vāyuḥ kasyacidvaśe jyotirdhūmādyavayavairmeghamutpādya varṣati akāṇḍa eva gagane kuto meghasya ḍambaraḥ svābhāvataḥ samīrasya samastavyāpi na stanau āpyaṃśā api viśliṣṭā bahavau [kh: -vo] nākṣigocarāḥ ete tu tritayākārā vargānityaṃ samīraṇe svasvātaṃtro maheśāno mārutaḥ śailanandini [kh: -nī] samīhitā vāyunāte bhaumāṃśādhūmarūpiṇaḥ yadā golakatā pattistadgarbhe māruteśvaraḥ [k: -taśvara] atrāpinibhṛto vākāṣṇyaṃ [kh: -yurauṣṇyaṃ] sṛjati dṛśyate bhaumāṃśagaulake tatra stimitānala saṃbhṛtaiḥ yadā tadaiva salilaṃ vāyustaimityavahninā vāyustaimityapākastu bahukālakṛtaḥ śive

punaḥ karakatā prāptaṃ tadeva salilaṃ kvacit dravarūpaṃ jalaṃ yadvat [kh: yadvāt] tadvat karakatāṃvrajet tatra vajre'ti kaṭhine taptāyaḥ piṇḍasannibhe śrotrajūrttikaronṝṇāmudbhave garjitadhvaniḥ golakāntaḥ [kh: -nta] sthitāddevi tadā vidyudvijṛṃbhaṇam nipatanti pavistomā vajrapātastadā bhavet aśaniryatra patati tatra dhvastaṃ talodari [kh: -rī] kṣaṇāt saṃhārati svecchā vārimeghānsamīraṇaḥ pakvāṃbu karakaśceti tattvākaṃ vajra ityapi [kh: ḍatyapi] sāṃketikairnnāmabhistu lokānvyavaharaṃtyamī indrovarṣati sūryo vā meghaḥ pitvāṃbudherjalam ityevamādirūpeṇa tadetanmattagarvitam [kh: -jalpitam] svarūpaṃ smyagevoktaṃ svataṃtrastena mārutaḥ yathāṇḍot pādane devi piṇḍot pattividhāvapi liṃgena kāminī kukṣau bindurūpovisṛjyate tasmin kṣaṇe yojayituṃ kaiścit piṇḍayituṃṭinaiḥ [kh: -dinaiḥ] kaiścid bhujadvaṃdvamapi kaiścit pādadvayaṃdinaiḥ ahobhiḥ kaiścidaṃgeṣu karttumasthinibhūriśaḥ svayaṃ jīvamayī bhūyasthātuṃ tasya hṛdaṃbuje punargolāt [kh: punaggolāt] pātayituṃ vivṛtadvārabaṃdhanāt sarvaṃ ca karttuṃśaknoti bhagavānmāruteśvaraḥ vinānena tṛṇāgrasyāpyava spaṃdo [k: svaṃdo] na suṃdari [kh: -rī] tadā svamakhilaṃ rūpaṃ vīrasya vaśatāṃ nayet aṇimādi guṇaiśvarya yuktaḥ khelati pārvati [kh: -tī] vijayaṃ sahasādadyān mahāyāgodbhavaṃ phalam

mārutasya svataṃtratvaṃ kimanyat kathayāmi te devatānāṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ pravivicyate devataḥ kecidicchaṃti maṃtrābhyāsa vyapekṣiṇaḥ cakrapāṇiścatārkṣyāṃ kodurgāmahiṣamardinī [k: -ma * * mardini] sākṣasūtrā ca vāgdevī tyetādṛgvāk pramāṇataḥ vicārastatrakarttavyaḥ śrūyatāṃ varavarṇini [kh: -nī] dhānādi vyavahārāṇāmasyadhānupavarttitaḥ [kh: -manyadhā-] vidyābhāvanayoraikye tāvat kartṛtvamiṣyatām kiṃcayukti [kh: -yatti] virodhā hi deva dehitva kalpane yadyataivamahīloke tat syānmārgānuṣadharmatā na hi merutaṭopānta svarganityanivāsinaḥ atyantaviprakṛṣṭeṣu deśeṣvāvāsamīyuṣī [kh: -ṣi] naitadasti yato daivaṃ śarīravadavidṛvaṃ[kh: -pidhruvam] viditvā ca samāgamyā yāgeṣuhaviraśnute evaṃ cedaparāśaṃkā naiṣā devi [kh: - devī] samaṃjasā yugavanmaṃtrajāpe ca yugapaścāhutāvapi yadyeka sannidhānaṃ syāt savane saṃpravarttate natvetadasti yoginyaḥ [kh: -yaṃ] khalu sarvatra devatāḥ ekaiva devatā bhinnairākāraistatra tatra ca idamapyavicāreṇa cārucāru vilocane [kh: -te] phalaṃ kinnubhavet tāsāṃ yajñebhakṣaṇabhikṣayā devatā siddhimartyo [kh: -matyo] hi tāsāṃ kena kṣudhodayaḥ devatā sannidadhate yajñe yajñe pṛthagvidhe kṣudhaṃ vā kena vā devi [kh: devī] notpādayitumīśate kintubhakta paratrāṇa mātra eṣa samudyamaḥ

kiṃphalā pekṣayā bhaktatrāṇaṃ kurvaṃti devatāḥ taccāpi [kh: yaccāpi] phalamātmīyayogasidhyaiva [kh: -tmiyya-] jāyatām tāsāmapi punaḥ pūjyamavasyaṃ vācyameva te devāntaramapekṣā syāt taddevaṃ devatāntaram antato yadi [kh: yati] viśrāntiḥ kutrāpi pratipadyate tadādāveva sanneṣṭaṃ vṛthādhājadurāgrahaḥ [kh: vṛdhādhāṭī-] siddhimatyapi jaṃtūnāṃ [kh: -nā] trāṇārthaṃ sannidhāyinī yadi svabhāvāt karuṇā devatānāṃ mahaujasām na kopiloke dāridradīnātmāmānavo [kh: dāridrya-] bhavet karuṇā ce devameva bhavitavyaṃ maheśvari [kh: -rī] yacchaṃtīnāṃ devatānāṃ vaṇijāmiva kākṛpā dehavatvamurīkṛtya kṛtā unmattajalpavat asminnānaṃdataṃtre [k: * * nnā-] tu tatpaścāt pravivicyate havyagrahaṇakāle [kh: * vya-] tu gatvāyānti punastviti yathātra bhūmivalaye grāmapallipurādikam [kh: -valli-] yadaivabhāratevarṣe yadā deśaṃ pṛthagvidhāḥ na tāsu devatābhāvaḥ kopyastyanyonyamudgataḥ vasanti vāmanayane nāntānyonyamupāsate [kh: nātrānyonya-] sarvatrajātayaḥ santi nānāveṣakriyojvalāḥ yacāpi nirnnimeṣatvaṃ yacca nāra [kh: sāra] śarīratā tat sarvaṃ tat tadurviṃ ca viśiṣṭauṣadhisevayā pūrvamevamayā proktā yadaivamaṇimaṃtrayoḥ manvāmahe [kh: -ho] mahādevi [kh: -vī] devatātvaṃ na kiṃcana tadbhūjavastu śaktyaiva na tu jāti svabhāvataḥ pratyakṣato na dṛśyante dīrghāyuṣṭvādi siddhayaḥ

bhinnajātairupāyaiśca na kathaṃ devi setsyati nariaścanaravṛttaṃtaḥ [kh: -nta] surairvānānu budhyate kimayaḥ saṃti tadvad bhūgole bhinnāścajātayaḥ sarvadā tṛptimantaśca yacca tatra divaukasaḥ iyad bhūmirmahadbhūtaṃ viśālā sarvagarbbhiṇi [kh: -ṇī] satvairbahuvidhairjjuṣṭā vahvībhirjātibhirvṛdhā [k: ba * bhir- -tā] sarveṣāmapi jantūnāmāśrayaṃ ca samāyuṣām phaṇāmaṇḍalaparyaka [kh: paṇā-] nityakhelanabālikā mahānadībhiruddāmā hārālibhirivojvalā śliṣṭeva vāyunā tena śailālipulakākulā tamālaśyāmale nābhorāśinā vidhṛtāṃbarā caturddaśajagatprātamūrtinā [kh: -prota-] meruṇāśritā kvacid dūratarairdīrghairvīraṇaireva saṃvṛtā kvacillohamayākārā kvacittāmramayā kṛtiḥ ilāvṛtādi varṣādau kvacanasvarṇarūpiṇī maṇḍalaurvṛtā] daśanāḍīyutā kvāpi kvacinnyūnadinā [kh: -cinyūna-] smṛtā ṣaṇmāsamātraṃ kvacanarātri saṃbhavavarjitā kvacit kākamukhairmartyaiḥ kvacidgṛdhramukhairnnaraiḥ iththaṃ bahuvidhākārā sarvādhāranijākṛtiḥ evaṃ samastabhūcakra vāsināṃ sarvadehinām maṃtrāśca santi [k: * *] bahavaḥ phalānivividhāni ca devānāṃ ca samānaiṣārītiḥ [kh: -ti] svarganivāsinām ṛcikāmāyaśaskāmā devā vai satramāsata hṛdayaṃ gamayā śaktyātarkaiścanyāya karkaśaiḥ

tarhidaivāni [kh: tairhi-] sarvāṇi viśvarūpāṇi kiṃ vada śaśaśṛṅgasya yat kiñcidrūpaṃ kva pratipadyate yathābhūmyaṃbu tejobhiḥ śabdena marutāpi ca kvacit padārthairurvyādyaiḥ paṃcabhirnnirmalātmabhiḥ pratyaṃtabhāvanādārḍhyād devatā rūpamīdṛśam yāgāśca dvividhā proktā yajvanopidvibhedinaḥ pauṇḍarīkaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vājapeyādayaḥ priye śrīyāgaśyāmalā yāgaḥ śaṃbhuyāgastathā paraḥ heraṃbayāgo gopālayāgaḥ sūryamakhastathā bhuktipradhānāḥ suśroṇi gopitāḥ parikīrttitāḥ prakaṭā śrī makhādīnāṃ yaṣṭārogopitāḥ [kh: -tā] smṛtāḥ prāmāṇyamubhayatrāpi viśeṣastatra kathyate rājasaprakṛtīnāṃ tu prakaṭeṣṭaḥ prathiyyasi [kh: pradhīyasi] antarmukhānāṃ vīrāṇāṃ matyaṃtaunnatyakāṃkṣiṇām gupteṣṭireva niyataṃ phalasaṃpatti kāṃkṣiṇī tad devatā svarūpaṃ ca paṃcavastvekatātmatā gururvidyā dhyāna kḷptirmanaśca [kh: kluptir-] pavanastathā caturthyaṃtaḥ śabda eva devateti sphuṭaṃ jaguḥ gurvādivastu saṃbheda eva devatavigraham te hi siddhaṃ prayacchaṃti te tu nirbhāvanā mudā dvādaśāṃta sarojāṃtaḥ karṇikātryaśamaṇḍale [kh: -śramaṇḍale] tanmadhye sahalakṣārṇahaṃ sadvyakṣarapīṭhikām tadaharjātapādābhau navapallavakomalau raktaśuklamayākārau raktaśuklanijatviṣau gurubhāvanametat tu mantrabhāvanamucyate

ratnastaṃbhasamākārā dhāladhalya [kh: thālathalya] sphurat tanuḥ ādivarṇaṃ samārabhya yāvanmaṃtrākṣarāvadhi pādukopari vidyāsyād adhastādekatātayoḥ tasmācchrī [kh: -cchre] deśikāṃghreśca maṃtramūrtteścanobhidā ādvādaśāntamunnamre hṛtsthāne kamalaṃ smaret tanmadhye dhyānamiṣṭārtha padaprāptikaraṃ bhajet ekavaktrebhujadvaṃdvaṃ kvacid bāhucatuṣṭayam kvacid yadā śirṣasaṃkhyā [kh: -khyaṃ] tadvaiguṇyena bāhavaḥ viṣṇūpaśliṣṭa deveṣu dhyānabhedād vilocanāḥ dhyānabhedāt stanānamramadhyāścandranibhānanāḥ atiprasannāḥ karttavyāḥ madāruṇavilocanāḥ dhyāna kḷpteriyaṃ [kh: klapti-] proktā bhāvanasāravigrahā tat pūrvamevagaditaṃ mayāmadhurabhāṣiṇi [kh: -ṇī] evaṃ gurvādibhiḥ paṃca padārthairbhāvanānvitaiḥ maṃdaṃ madhyaṃ ca tīvraṃ ca tatredhābhaktavarṣaṇī [k: tattre-] pūrvajanmakṛtān doṣān ihajanmasthitāngatān vācāṃsiddhiṃ vacaḥ siddhiṃ cirāyuṣyaṃ mahadyaśaḥ svayaṃ śivatvānubhavaṃ svecchayābhāvakalpanam saṃkalpasiddhidāṃ sarvalokānugrahakāritām īṣatprasāde nīcānāmapyaindra padadāyitām tīvraṃ tu devatā rūpaṃ vitaratyadri kanyake tīvre tu devatā rūpe triṃśadvarṣāṇyu pāsate siddhāṃti taṃ maheśāni tadetat svātmasāt kuru yadrahasya parijñānāt [kh: -nād] vidyāḥ sarvāśca siddhidāḥ ye dhārayanti manasā te bhaktābhāgyaśālinaḥ

svarūpataḥ śaktipātāt svabhāvena samāgatān [kh: -tāt] kiṃcid ratnamayaṃ vastu pratibiṃba na laṃpaṭam yadratnādyajaḍaṃ [k: ya * tnā-] tatrāpyevaṃ tāmarasānane athāṃbu vastuni preśyaḥ śaktipātaparākramaḥ śaktipātaṃ vinātatra mādhuryasya kva saṃbhavaḥ khadyotatārakāmukhyā kiṃcit tejastamoharaḥ mārttāṃḍabhairavākāraṃ pratāpairatiduḥ saham hetunāśaktipātena vinānaiva hi dṛśyate ekonīlaḥ prāṇaharaḥ prāṇadaḥ kaścanāparaḥ ekomarutkṣaṇādeva jagadghaṭanalaṃpaṭaḥ tadvacchakteḥ [kh: -kte] śaktipātona sarvatra kvacit kvacit yathā bhumyādikāṃśānāṃ saṃsārogaṇanādhikaḥ [kh: -thikaḥ] samudrabheriyaṃ poṣṭaghuṭikā [kh: poṭṭa-] jhallarīmukhaiḥ varṇātmakāstu ye śabdā nityāḥ sarvagatāścate sarvagā apidṛśyaṃte [kh: lipidṛśyaṃte] nābhivyakterapekṣayā nityatvaṃ ca maheśāni pratyabhijñā pramāṇataḥ sa evāṃgaṃ gakārotrayajñadattena ghuṣyate tasmāt sarvepyamīśabdāḥ nityāḥ sarvagatā api utpannasya dṛśorāśiryasya [kh: -śirpyasa] brahmāṇḍamapyaṇu uttarottaramatyaṃta vitatā vīravaṃdite śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati tājikriyāguṇadravya bhedādbhinnāsahasradhā vṛkṣolatāḥ [kh: -tā] tṛṇaṃ ceti śabdāderjjātivikriyāḥ [k: -de * * vi-] dhūmraḥ pītaḥ śyāmalaścāpyete śabdaguṇoththitāḥ ghaṭaḥ paṭaśca kuḍyaṃcetyetādravyagatāgiraḥ

āgalāṃtaṃ mayā pītvā vamyatīti prakārataḥ kāminī sammitaścānyaḥ [kh: -nya] strīprakārohyayaṃ smṛtaḥ āgamo'pi ca tat sārabhūtaḥ kamalalocane asaṃdihānaḥ saṃdehāt pratyavāyaṃ vicintayan gṛhṇātyeva nirātaṃkaḥ [kh: -kas] tena sidhyati vartmanāt [kh: -vān] suhṛtsammitaśabdastu suhṛdvākya vaducyate paurāṇikairabhihitaṃ vyāsādyairmaṃtraśālibhiḥ dharmaputravadekaiva na tu duryodhanādivat [kh: dhuryo-] upadeśaṃ diśatiyaḥ sarātirmitrasammitaḥ samastamapi saṃgītaṃ bharatādiprakalpitam alaṃkārairgaṇaścāpi ritibhirvṛttibhistathā abhidhālakṣaṇāgauṇa vṛttyāvaktroktibhistathā vividhairhṛdayāṃ hlādajanakaiḥ kāvyavartmabhiḥ sammatā [k: * * *] na śabda brahmajaladhau śaktipātastu sarvataḥ maṃtrabhāvoguḍākeśi ratnatvamiva pārthive ānupūrvāccanaivetya [k: -pūrvyācca-] vedāgamagatematau 185k) ānupūrvāsya nityatvaṃ na tathā [kh: +tra] maheśvarī ānupūrvaṃ viśvadhane maṃtrāniḥ śaktayaḥ smṛtāḥ śaktipātasvabhāvena varttate vārijekṣaṇe abhivyakti punasteṣāṃ deśikeṃdropadeśitaḥ anādya vidyāmālinyatamaḥ kajjalamārjjane saptākūpārato yānāṃ [kh: yāna] gaṇyaṃte pṛṣatānyapi sarveṣāmapi maṃtrāṇāṃ sraṣṭāvedeṣu saṃgatāḥ tato'pi maṃtraḥ saurāḥ [kh: -rā] syuḥviryavaṃto [kh: syur-] vilāsinī

tato'pi daurgāmaṃtrāstu dūrgatidhvaṃsa tat parāḥ tatopi maṃtrā varyāsyuḥsarvasvatyabhidhāyakāḥ [kh: paryāsyuḥ-] 186k) tataḥ pūrvāmnāyabhavā maṃtrā vīryamahattarāḥ tebhyo'pi paścimāmnāya maṃtraśreṇirmahīyasī [kh: -hiyyasi] tāsu vidyā svakūpārāsthānīyāsu [kh: -niyyāsu] maheśvari [kh: -rī] teṣvapyudagrāvārttālī maṃtrāḥ siddhipradāyakāḥ tato'pi lalitādevyo daśabhedasamudbhavāḥ te ṣvapidve [kh: -vidye] mahāvidye saiveyaṃ saṃprakīrttitā [kh: sa-] sevaṃte svasvarakṣārthaṃ svaśakteścāpi labdhaye sevaṃte sakalā vidyā vedāgamamahormayaḥ sarvavedāśca sarvāṇi purāṇānimaheśvari [kh: -rī] guptatvena viviṃcaṃti natajjānaṃti [kh: nata jñānaṃti] durddhiyaḥ na jānaṃti tamomūḍhā lalitāṃ vedamātaram sarasvatī kavīṃdrāṇāṃ yogināṃ cāpi bhairavī padmāvatīyaṃ bauddhānāṃ tārā ca tarale kṣaṇe mahārājñi ca [kh: -jñiśca] saurāṇāṃ śraddhādruhiṇasevinām kimanyataskarāṇāṃ ca luṇṭikādevatā smṛtā yodyadāditya saṃkāśā sa cā pekṣu sṛṇīguṇā nāṃdīyāgasya paṭale yāni proktāni suṃdari [kh: -rī] tānisarvāṇi deveśī śrīcakranagaraṃ [kh: * *cakra-] smṛtam sāmrājñī [kh: -gni] tatra lalitā pradānā śyāmalāṃbikā devī kroḍamukhī sarvaśatruraktāsavonmadā kāmeśvaryādikasta śrīdevyo rājasuhṛṃttamāḥ vaśinyādyāstu vāgdevyaḥ kavayaścārucāṭavaḥ 188k) sarvasiddhyādikā maṃtra [kh: maṃtrā] vicārapaṭumaṃtriṇaḥ

bhukteṣu dīyamānasya [kh: diyya-] sauṃdaryadhanaveśmanaḥ kāmākarṣiṇikā mukhyā navaśītarucaḥ kalāḥ sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī mudrā mukhyāmudrānava priye aṇimādyā mahādevi [kh: -vī] vinodāyendrajālataḥ brahmādyāstu mahābhoge saṃtataṃ sevituṃ purāḥ caturdaśajagatyaṃba proccitāḥ [kh: -tā] saudhabhūmayaḥ evaṃ prakāśitā vidyā sihmāsana maheśvarī tasmāt sihmāsanākhyeva triṣulokeṣu viśrutā ānaṃdavallividyeyaṃ samastānaṃdagarbhiṇī ānaṃdadevī lalitā lalitānaṃdabhairavī samastaśāstrasaṃbodhyā vīravaiśvātmadāyinī cintyamānaivamadhurā jalpyamānaivasidhyadā [kh: -ṇaiva-] nānayāsadṛśaṃ kiṃcit [kh: kiṃci] triṣulokeṣu vidyate yadānaṃdamahāvidyāmavadhatte sakṛtpumān samasta saubhāgya yutosiddhimān [k: -man] sakṛdathate [kh: sakṛdedhate] paraṃdhāmāpicidrūpaṃ yato liṃga samāśritam [kh: -ta] amarāśca surāyakṣā rakṣogaṃdharva kinnarāḥ niliṃpakāśca pramathāḥ [kh: -dhāḥ] sarvedevā maheśvari [kh: -rī] siṃhājagājāśca śārdūlāḥ śarabhāśca tathā mṛgāḥ prāṇaspaṃdana cinmātrā rūpāḥ sarve vijātayaḥ tasmāt pārvati hastānme pādānmūrdhastathorasaḥ [kh: -mūrghnas-] adhyāpi paśyadeveśi mamaliṃgaṃ hi pūjyate svayaṃbhubāṇaliṃgaṃ ca tathā sphaṭka liṃgakam pārthivaṃ liṃgamīśāni tathā [kh: tadā] rājata liṃgakam samastaiḥ pūjyate devi sarvasaubhāgya kāmukaiḥ
etad yacca śṛṇotyaṃba [kh: śruṇo -] etad yaccāpi naṃdati etaccavastu vyākhyāti vidhinaktasya [k: vivi-] yaḥ kramam malliṃgārcana heturyastvayā pṛṣṭhaḥ kuleśvarī
